| **Dear Friend,** Last night, I had the honor of attending President Donald Trump's State of the Union address, and let me tell you something:

**The wins are real.
The momentum is building.
America is BACK.
And the State of the Union is STRONG.** We’re seeing crime fall as law enforcement is empowered instead of undermined. We’re restoring order at our border instead of chaos. We’re putting American workers, families, and communities FIRST again. **But one moment stood out.**

**While Democrats refused to stand in recognition of Iryna Zarutska and her family, I stood proudly.** This young woman fled a war torn country seeking a better life in America, only to be tragically killed by a repeat offender who had been in and out of jail more than a dozen times and **was even released by former Governor Roy Cooper.** That is unacceptable. When elected officials refuse to stand for victims and ignore the rule of law, the American people see it clearly. The radical Left is not backing down. They want to reverse every gain. They want open borders, soft on crime policies, and weakness on the world stage. We cannot let that happen. If we are going to keep this momentum going, I need you with me. **Will you stand with me today and contribute 25, 50, or even 100 dollars to help us continue fighting for a strong America?**

body:
The new Marquette poll shows our campaign leading the Democratic field
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260225-2554)
Peter,
The Marquette Law School Poll — the gold standard in Wisconsin politics — just came out, and our campaign is in first place in the Democratic primary for governor.
[](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260225.Xa7p6v&refcode=em20260225-2554&t=1&akid=2554%2E105371%2EVry7kQ)
We’ve nearly doubled our support since October. We’re beating candidates with more than twice our name recognition. And the issues we’ve been fighting for since day one? Voters are right there with us.
Here’s what the poll found:
* 70% of Wisconsin voters say data center deals cost more than they’re worth — up 15 points in four months. We were the [first campaign](https://act.francescahong.com/go/5102?t=2&akid=2554%2E105371%2EVry7kQ) to call these deals out, and we’re still the only one with a plan to stop them.
* 56% disapprove of how ICE is enforcing immigration laws. 61% say the killing of Alex Pretti was not justified. We’ve been [standing up to this brutality](https://act.francescahong.com/go/5103?t=3&akid=2554%2E105371%2EVry7kQ) from the beginning — in the legislature, in the streets, and on this campaign.
* Inflation is the #1 issue in Wisconsin, with 70% of voters very concerned about cost of living. That’s exactly why we built this entire campaign around permanent affordability — universal childcare, paid leave for all, fully funded schools, and fairer, cheaper [healthcare](https://act.francescahong.com/go/5104?t=4&akid=2554%2E105371%2EVry7kQ).

We didn’t wait for the polls to tell us what to care about. We led with our principles because we know what Wisconsinites have been asking for since I started traveling across the state in 2020. That’s what this campaign is about: delivering on the real issues that real people care about.
But I have to be honest with you: First place also means a target on our back. Every other campaign is going to look at this poll and come after us. We need the resources to keep growing, keep organizing, and keep showing up in every corner of this state.
**[Can you chip in $10 to keep this momentum going?](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260225.Xa7p6v&refcode=em20260225-2554&t=5&akid=2554%2E105371%2EVry7kQ)**
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260225.Xa7p6v&amount=5&refcode=em20260225-2554&t=24&akid=2554%2E105371%2EVry7kQ)**
With gratitude,
— Fran

body:
Leading People Forward [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/People%20to%20Know%20%281%29.png]
Through my work, I get to meet so many great people. And in the months ahead, I am going to make sure everyone I know gets to know them, too. In this critical election year, there are a lot of people raising their hands to help put our communities and country on track. I am proud to support them, and hope you will, too.
My friend Dexter McCoy is running for Fort Bend County Judge. He is exactly the kind of person we need in office. He has a real vision for Fort Bend and a genuine commitment to the county and the people who live there.
DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe260224?refcode=lpfe260224]
Here’s why this matters so much.
At a moment when our politics too often reward chaos and corruption, Dexter has taken a different approach: treating every decision as a reflection of the community he serves. He understands that an effective government is about expanding opportunities and improving people’s lives.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe260224?refcode=lpfe260224 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe260224?refcode=lpfe260224]
I’ve teamed up to take this message to the community, and to deliver for our community, like the effort to create a community space for seniors in TX07’s Mission Bend. Dexter and I worked together to secure funding to provide seniors with a safe community space that could serve as a warming and cooling center, offer public programming, host events, and provide fitness equipment. People who’ve raised families here, who’ve worked their entire lives, and are spending their retirement years here, need a place to come together. I’m proud to say we secured the funds to build the Mission Bend Senior Center from Fort Bend’s resources and congressional project funding.
So, while there are people who benefit when people stop believing the government can work for us all, leaders like Dexter prove they’re wrong. Dexter is exactly the kind of person who works every day to show that government can work for everyone, and to make it happen.
I’m proud to support Dexter McCoy to be our next Fort Bend County Judge, and I hope you’ll join me by making a contribution that will be split between his campaign and my Leading People Forward Political Action Committee, which supports Dexter and other candidates in critical races across our community and country.
It is critical that voters across Fort Bend County hear Dexter’s message before they make their decision. That means organizing volunteers, reaching undecided voters, and maintaining momentum all through Election Day next Tuesday. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe260224?refcode=lpfe260224]

name: Jon Ossoff
subject: Trump talking smack
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
| Team –– Donald Trump came to Georgia.

The White House sent him here to do damage control on tariffs and health care.

But he just couldn’t help himself: instead of trying to defend his price-inflating tariffs and insurance-premium-doubling health care policy, he resorted to repeating conspiracy theories about the 2020 election — an election he lost in Georgia despite pressuring Georgia election officials to “find” him more votes.

Maybe he’s been watching the rallies I’ve been holding across Georgia, where thousands have turned out in opposition to his corruption and depravity. Because he took a moment to throw some insults my way.

Now, Donald Trump has been insulting me for a long time. But this time, it didn’t seem like his heart was in it. I think you could see in his eyes and hear in his voice that he knows he’s lost the American people. That he knows his Presidency is slipping away. That he can feel Georgians, and people nationwide, preparing to deliver a decisive rebuke of historic abuses of power.

Because as I travel across Georgia, what I hear is more and more people of every background and belief reject Trump’s chaos and corruption. And it's not just Democrats and independents. It’s Republicans too!

More and more Republicans take me aside, or they call me on the phone. They tell me they don’t like where this President has taken us. And they tell me they’re going to support a Democrat for the first time.

But here’s the thing: as he gets more desperate, his abuses become more dangerous. From sending Tulsi Gabbard on ballot raids in Fulton County, Georgia, to threatening a national takeover of elections, we have to be ready for anything.

We have to turn out LANDSLIDE margins of victory ... victories so decisive that no scheme or plot hatched in the White House can foil the will of the people.

And we have to defend voting rights with unprecedented tenacity and resources.

**I need your help to do these things.**

[**If you’re able to, please split $10 right now between the Voter Protection Project and my reelection campaign for U.S. Senate. Now we must win again. We will win again.

name: Gov. Andy Beshear
subject: Trump's SOTU:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by In This Together PAC
body:
Getting our country back on track means being honest about where we are and bold about where we need to go.

Peter,

The President's State of the Union Address confirms one thing: He isn't listening to the American people. Families are struggling, not enjoying some "golden age." And he didn't protect Medicaid - he gutted it.

Last night, we saw a President whose understanding of what his policies have done to our country is entirely divorced from reality. And we saw a man who takes pleasure in attacking, bullying, and insulting his political opponents and people who disagree with him.

He claimed a booming economy and respect around the world.

_While I want that to be the truth, it couldn’t be farther from reality._

As Governor of Kentucky, **what I see and hear every day tells a different story.**

I talk to parents working harder than ever and still falling behind, small business owners squeezed by rising costs, young people who did everything right but still can't see a path to owning a home, and seniors anxious about prescription prices and the future of Social Security — and they're feeling this strain in today's America.

Trump boasts about his tariffs, but those same tariffs cost the average American an additional $1,000 just last year.

He praises the work of Republicans in Congress for passing his agenda, but that agenda will kick 17 million Americans off of their health insurance, double premiums for thousands more, and close rural hospitals all across the nation—all for the sake of tax breaks for the wealthiest Americans and corporations.

And his claim about incredible job growth? The U.S. added fewer jobs in the past year than in the year before he was elected.

Peter, Trump made it clear that his message for the country is that everything is booming. But families in Kentucky and across the country feel like they're barely hanging on. I believe in an America where hard work is rewarded, where healthcare is affordable, where public education is strong, and where your fundamental rights aren't up for political bargaining. **I believe the government should be making all of that happen for its people, but the Trump Administration is working to take it away.**

Getting our country back on track means being honest about where we are and bold about where we need to go. It means investing in working families, protecting our freedoms, and refusing to accept the politics of hate and division that the Trump Administration champions.

**[Donald Trump wants us to believe there's nothing out there that's better than him and his Republican yes-men. But we have leaders across the country who are stepping up and fighting back against his backward agenda at all levels of government. If you're ready to get our country back on track, build an economy and a democracy that truly works for working families and restore the American dream, I'm asking you to support our work today to get these incredible leaders elected. clean_body: Getting our country back on track means being honest about where we are and bold about where we need to go. Peter, The President's State of the Union Address confirms one thing: He isn't listening to the American people. Families are struggling, not enjoying some "golden age." And he didn't protect Medicaid - he gutted it. Last night, we saw a President whose understanding of what his policies have done to our country is entirely divorced from reality. And we saw a man who takes pleasure in attacking, bullying, and insulting his political opponents and people who disagree with him. He claimed a booming economy and respect around the world. While I want that to be the truth, it couldn’t be farther from reality. As Governor of Kentucky, what I see and hear every day tells a different story. I talk to parents working harder than ever and still falling behind, small business owners squeezed by rising costs, young people who did everything right but still can't see a path to owning a home, and seniors anxious about prescription prices and the future of Social Security — and they're feeling this strain in today's America. Trump boasts about his tariffs, but those same tariffs cost the average American an additional $1,000 just last year. He praises the work of Republicans in Congress for passing his agenda, but that agenda will kick 17 million Americans off of their health insurance, double premiums for thousands more, and close rural hospitals all across the nation—all for the sake of tax breaks for the wealthiest Americans and corporations. And his claim about incredible job growth? The U.S. added fewer jobs in the past year than in the year before he was elected. Peter, Trump made it clear that his message for the country is that everything is booming. But families in Kentucky and across the country feel like they're barely hanging on. I believe in an America where hard work is rewarded, where healthcare is affordable, where public education is strong, and where your fundamental rights aren't up for political bargaining. I believe the government should be making all of that happen for its people, but the Trump Administration is working to take it away. Getting our country back on track means being honest about where we are and bold about where we need to go. Friend, I’m from Detroit, the most beautiful, Blackest city in the country that has always birthed movements—from workers’ rights to racial and environmental justice. Black History Month is every single month of the year for our community, which has been home to so many Black trailblazers and history-makers, including civil rights leaders such as **Mother Rosa Parks** , **Rev. C.L. Franklin** , **James Boggs** , **Malcolm X** , **Nelson “Jack” Edwards** , and**John Conyers Jr.** It’s an honor to represent part of Detroit and other majority-Black cities like Inkster and Southfield, and every day I’m inspired by local Black residents who are leading the way in advancing justice, delivering mutual aid, building thriving communities, expanding our rights, making powerful art, and working toward Black liberation. I’ve celebrated some of these leaders on the House floor, such as **Mama Lila Cabbil** , **Mother Gladys “Peggy” Noble** , **Fred Durhal Jr.** , **Chef Maxcel “Max” Hardy** , **Mother Patricia “Patt” Braxton** , Principal **Markisha Stovall** of Madison Carver Academy, and **Rev. Dr. JoAnn Watson**. And I work regularly with incredible change-makers like **Pastor Velma Jean Overman** (photo below) and her group Operation Refuge—and **Cassy Jones-McBryde** who founded the Michigan Chamber for Reproductive Justice who fights for women of color and working families. [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqvNYN-Nf8VmRD3J8PbgJvGmcxt9YrEcdYK3wGY337J3qyw1c0yXn0K4rROCaHNoLQ32R2LC9IcLRitnYdIpJd7KOPwRf3zKW-bhfpVQQg8zOtojyQJ5ExoSGYbtrZIfF0cKrpIigzWUgzfDpSLBTwm1opAxxXAWAQs2bJY0hw3GUhthv4midd7cXDSjiO6Wvzm5f6QTKcum6YILnWmcEVRabzUjSxgiA3ILHgx2NuoY0jftQy8bM4pxXTlt_qxl0TPcDIwz28-lZTmfXHzvNWx3xzDo-559KPOpPrhQNq5vLN65bJH3-iYBflxXA_zhemUdFfir1Bi4B-K8-NzJKNF9i2_AxfAxP_skyzgadJrFsFd6Ro9tOxveMsod5SwWfpvLMMivPpuBfdYme9gAiyct/4oh/mFJoOVUBQKiIs1VMLsdwDA/h1/h001.64egZ5wBwqsuuZGqaWsr6Op5fZYyWKB8DG6SL8ucES4) Last night I went to resist fascism and hate at the State of the Union, with **Dr. Fatou-Seydi Sarr** as my guest. She founded and leads the African Bureau for Immigration and Social Affairs (ABISA), which runs essential programs such as the Black Immigrant Bail Fund and the Black Migrant Itinerant Law Clinic. Directly impacted by increased ICE violence, Dr. Sarr and her team are empowering and supporting Black immigrant communities across the United States. We showed up yesterday to shine a light on how Black immigrants are uniquely targeted, and to make it clear that we’re not going anywhere. Each year my team and I run a civic engagement fellowship for young people, with a focus on Black and brown residents of our district. We named this fellowship in honor of **Mama Lila Cabbil** , a tireless advocate for social justice and racial justice, especially water and food justice. Mama Cabbil started the Detroit People’s Platform, co-founded the national anti-racist network Within Our Lifetime, and led the Rosa and Raymond Parks Institute for Self-Development. With Rosa Parks’ family, my team and I passed a law to recognize **Mother** **Rosa Parks** by renaming Detroit’s Grand River Post Office in her honor. Each year, we also run a campaign school for people in our community who are interested in running for office. One of our Rooted in Community Campaign school graduates is **Roslyn Ogburn,** a longtime environmental and housing community organizer and leader in food redistribution. I’m proud to endorse her as she runs for State Representative. body:
This is going to be a tough race.

| | | [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/1102?refcode=jtk280-fr-nd&t=1&akid=7784%2E400544%2Ed_bXKB)
---
Friend, I had to share this news right away.
**There are now FIVE Republicans running to flip New Mexico.** Several of them are using their own wealth to try to buy this race and bring an extreme agenda into our state.
_One self-funded multimillionaire GOP candidate has even said he’ll put $2 MILLION of his own money into his campaign._
I urgently need your grassroots support to ensure my campaign can compete. _**[So please, will you chip in $5 right now to help me close the gap on my $50,000 end-of-month goal and win in New Mexico?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5112?refcode=jtk280-fr-nd&amount=5&t=2&akid=7784%2E400544%2Ed_bXKB)**_
| | [Donate](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5112?refcode=jtk280-fr-nd&t=3&akid=7784%2E400544%2Ed_bXKB)
---
**I’ll be honest: This is going to be a tough race.** It's already clear that the GOP is going to try to buy this race, and unlike my multimillionaire opponent, I can't just write myself a check.
I don’t come from wealth, friend. I have never had the means to self-fund a campaign, unlike my wealthy opponents. I was a single mom living paycheck to paycheck, relying on government programs like SNAP, WIC, and Medicaid to help keep my child fed and healthy.
**So I know what it's like to struggle, and I also know that it takes a village, in both life and in politics. I strongly believe leaders should make people’s lives easier, not harder. We all want good roads, safe communities, strong education, access to parks, and affordable, healthy food to eat.**
That’s exactly why I’m better prepared to lead. I understand affordability because I’ve lived it. I know how critical strong public schools, accessible healthcare, and safe communities are because my family relied on them. These issues aren’t abstract to me, they’re personal. And beyond my lived experience, I’ve led at the highest levels of government, serving in Congress and as U.S. Secretary of the Interior, where I took on tough fights and delivered real results for communities across the country. I know how to fight for working families — and how to get things done.
Experience matters. Leadership matters. And I’m ready.
That's why I’m running to be the next governor of New Mexico, to build a better future for working families. But I need your help to reach my midnight fundraising goal to make that a reality:
**I'm running a people-powered campaign that relies on grassroots support from folks like you chipping in $5, $10, or whatever you can spare to help me go up against these self-funded multimillionaires.**_**[Please, will you chip in to help me win and keep New Mexico blue?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5112?refcode=jtk280-fr-nd&t=4&akid=7784%2E400544%2Ed_bXKB)**_

We all want good roads, safe communities, strong education, access to parks, and affordable, healthy food to eat. That’s exactly why I’m better prepared to lead. I understand affordability because I’ve lived it. I know how critical strong public schools, accessible healthcare, and safe communities are because my family relied on them. These issues aren’t abstract to me, they’re personal. And beyond my lived experience, I’ve led at the highest levels of government, serving in Congress and as U.S. Secretary of the Interior, where I took on tough fights and delivered real results for communities across the country. I know how to fight for working families — and how to get things done. Experience matters. Leadership matters. And I’m ready. That's why I’m running to be the next governor of New Mexico, to build a better future for working families. But I need your help to reach my midnight fundraising goal to make that a reality: I'm running a people-powered campaign that relies on grassroots support from folks like you chipping in $5, $10, or whatever you can spare to help me go up against these self-funded multimillionaires. If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | Thank you, Deb | | | | |

He kicked millions off their healthcare plans and doubled prices for millions more.
He cut working families off from life-saving access to food.

He takes bribes from billionaires in exchange for tax cuts and special favors.
He protects pedophiles like Epstein and covers up sex crimes.

Hi there, Peter. It’s George Takei.
I’m reaching out to you today not as an actor but as a concerned citizen. In a minute, I’m going to ask you to join me in supporting Jon Ossoff’s reelection campaign. If you know the stakes and are ready to pitch in, you can use this link: [**https://act.electjon.com/go/Donate**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-feb26.GJoCgS&refcode=em260224-2-f&t=2&akid=1718%2E5691347%2EhFj0ib)
Otherwise, let me tell you a little more about Jon Ossoff, and why I am all in to reelect him in 2026:
We’ve seen unprecedented levels of corruption and bigotry from this administration. Donald Trump and his advisors are pushing divisive and harmful rhetoric — all while trying to seize more and more power and disintegrate our Constitutionally protected freedoms.
I’ve dedicated my adult life to politics and activism because of my family’s experience. When I was five years old, my family and I were put into American internment camps. We lost everything. We were allowed to keep only what we could carry. It was a dark, harrowing time.
In the years after we were released from internment, my father instilled in us the vital role we all have in protecting our democracy. He saw what happens to people when elected officials are emboldened to act on their bigoted, xenophobic, and racist beliefs.
Seeing the Trump administration’s blatant abuse of power and disregard for human rights, now is the time to stand up and defend our fragile democracy from eroding into authoritarianism.
That’s why I’m supporting Jon Ossoff. Before Georgia elected him to serve in the Senate, Jon led a team of investigative journalists that uncovered government corruption and human rights abuses across the world. He is deeply committed to combatting the xenophobia and racism that grips this administration — and knows how to fight back against Trump because it’s not his first time taking on corrupt leaders like him.
But Jon is facing what will likely be the most competitive and expensive midterm Senate race in the nation. Republicans are eager to replace him with another rubber stamp for Trump’s agenda. They’ve made him their top target in 2026 and they’re going to spare no expense to flip his seat red.
[**We cannot afford to lose his leadership in a time like this. That's why I’m asking if you’ll join me in supporting Jon Ossoff by chipping in whatever you can afford to his reelection campaign. Any amount helps in a race this critical.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-feb26.GJoCgS&refcode=em260224-2-f&t=3&akid=1718%2E5691347%2EhFj0ib)
**[DONATE](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-feb26.GJoCgS&refcode=em260224-2-f&t=4&akid=1718%2E5691347%2EhFj0ib)**
Live long and prosper,
George Takei

He saw what happens to people when elected officials are emboldened to act on their bigoted, xenophobic, and racist beliefs. Seeing the Trump administration’s blatant abuse of power and disregard for human rights, now is the time to stand up and defend our fragile democracy from eroding into authoritarianism. That’s why I’m supporting Jon Ossoff. Before Georgia elected him to serve in the Senate, Jon led a team of investigative journalists that uncovered government corruption and human rights abuses across the world. He is deeply committed to combatting the xenophobia and racism that grips this administration — and knows how to fight back against Trump because it’s not his first time taking on corrupt leaders like him. But Jon is facing what will likely be the most competitive and expensive midterm Senate race in the nation. Republicans are eager to replace him with another rubber stamp for Trump’s agenda. They’ve made him their top target in 2026 and they’re going to spare no expense to flip his seat red. Live long and prosper, George Takei Paid for by Jon Ossoff for Senate

name: Christopher Ahuja for Congress
subject: We Need You in CA-32
body:
We have to do this together

| | | | | [|
---](https://chrisahuja.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=67424df89870d1cac00e55f46&id=5628962e7c&e=53c7d12fc7)
| | | | | | Dear Peter,
We heard from the President yesterday in his State of the Union — and if you’re like many families, you’re still asking the same question:
Why are grocery and rent prices high and not going down? Why does healthcare still cost so much?
At the groceries checkout counter. The gas pump. When the rent is due. And when a medical bill shows up.
You deserve better.
I’m running for Congress because with Brad Sherman in Congress, life is more expensive.
I will fight for lowering your costs.
**I will** :
* **Introduce federal price gouging legislation**
* **Support direct relief legislation** to lower economic burdens
* **Support housing policies that increase supply and protect renters**
* **Help first-time buyers build a future** in communities like Woodland Hills, Encino, Tarzana, Reseda, Winnetka, Canoga Park, Simi Valley and beyond.
* **Expand down-payment assistance programs**

And because corporate landlords drive up prices, **I will work to ban private equity hedge funds from buying single-family homes.**
This is your life, your future and [**I need you on my team to get involved, lend your voice, and demand better.**](https://chrisahuja.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=67424df89870d1cac00e55f46&id=da9008ca0e&e=53c7d12fc7)
Affordability is about housing supply, trade decisions, and wage growth.
Congress has a role in every one of those.
I’m running for Congress because with Brad Sherman in office, life is more expensive.
Economic dignity. That’s what we’re fighting for, together.

---

subject: ICYMI: Governor Abigail Spanberger signed off on Virginia’s new congressional maps
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Virginians for Fair Elections
body:
We don’t have much time to make sure voters understand what’s at stake.
# [](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/629?refcode=em20260225-238&t=1&akid=238%2E12592%2EY8Dor7)
ICYMI: Governor Abigail Spanberger signed off on Virginia’s new congressional maps.
That means the new lines are set, and it’s on us to turn out Virginians to vote YES on the redistricting amendment this April.
[**If you’re all-in and want to fuel our work, pitch in $3 or any amount now. Early voting starts next week, so time is running out to reach voters before ballots are cast.**](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260225_2.8mmMPh&amount=3&refcode=20260225-238&t=2&akid=238%2E12592%2EY8Dor7)
**[Donate $3 ››](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260225_2.8mmMPh&amount=3&refcode=20260225-238&t=21&akid=238%2E12592%2EY8Dor7)**
After Republican legislatures across the country rushed to rig their own maps at Donald Trump’s request, Virginia stepped up to protect our fair and free elections.
These new maps create a real opportunity to level the playing field.
But here’s the catch: **None of it matters if voters don’t turn out and vote YES on the redistricting amendment this April.**
If the amendment fails, Virginians’ voices in Congress could be diluted by partisan gerrymandering happening in other states. If it passes, we level the playing field.
We don’t have much time to make sure voters understand what’s at stake.
[**Can you chip in $3 to help us get the word out across Virginia? Every dollar goes toward voter education, outreach, and mobilization in these critical final weeks.**](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260225_2.8mmMPh&amount=3&refcode=20260225-238&t=22&akid=238%2E12592%2EY8Dor7)

Virginians for Fair Elections

subject: Rose's Response to the State of the Union
body:
He touted stock market gains and lower gas prices while millions of Americans struggle to make rent, feed their kids, and pay for medicine.

| | | | | [|

| | | | | |
## Rose’s Response to Trump’s 2026 SOTU
---
| | Hello friends,
Last night, the President delivered what may go down in history for its length — not its substance. He touted stock market gains and lower gas prices while millions of Americans struggle to make rent, feed their kids, and pay for medicine.

[**The Democrats need BOLD representatives to stand up to Trump and the MAGA agenda. If you can, please send a small donation so we can GROW our campaign for People, Peace, and Planet in CA-02. My campaign is powered by regular folks, not billionaires and corporate interests.**](https://roseforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=35bf91c695e8f4a5dc8a9dd42&id=7271714552&e=8c53948e4c)
**PEOPLE** We believe the state of our union’s health isn’t measured by the Dow reaching $50,000. It’s measured by how families are faring.
* Working families are squeezed by high costs and stagnant wages.
* Healthcare, housing, and childcare remain unaffordable.
* Seniors and veterans are scared of benefits cuts.

While Trump’s speech painted a rosy picture of the economy, American households have ran up more debt than ever before.
**PEACE** We reject the framing of “peace through strength.” Peace is built through diplomacy, de-escalation, and mutual respect.
* We must say no to war with Iran.
* We cannot equate patriotism with more militarization.
* We cannot keep funding war and genocide abroad, and militarism at home.

A truly strong nation means one that has the confidence to work toward peaceful solutions.
---
| |
**PLANET** Tonight’s address barely mentioned the climate crisis, signaling once again the denial of science and our now lived experience of climate disasters that have increased in magnitude. We need leadership that:
* Invests in clean energy and resilient infrastructure.
* Reduces emissions while creating union jobs.
* Protects public lands, water, and future generations.

[**Can you contribute a small amount today to help lift our campaign for People, Peace, and Planet to the next level?**](https://roseforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=35bf91c695e8f4a5dc8a9dd42&id=662c18aeb6&e=8c53948e4c)
Where Trump’s speech offered rhetoric, our agenda offers tangible outcomes:
* Lower healthcare costs, affordable housing, and real wage growth.
* Peaceful global leadership.
* Invests in clean energy and resilient climate solutions that work for all.
* A thriving **People · Peace · Planet** doesn’t come from applause lines, it comes from justice, equity, and bold action.

---

name: Justice Democrats
subject: Pastor Haynes says Free Palestine.

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter, we’re less
than one week away from the Texas Democratic primary and the opportunity
to add a new anti-AIPAC champion for human rights and peace to our team in
Congress.

Reverend Frederick Haynes III has been saying it from the pulpit for
years, and he’s still saying it now as a candidate for Congress in TX-30:
Free Palestine.

Pastor Haynes was a leading member of a coalition of Black pastors who
lobbied for a ceasefire in Gaza in January 2024.

The progressive Senior Pastor at Friendship-West Baptist Church in Texas
gave a powerful sermon on Israel’s occupation and genocide of Palestinians
in 2023:

“The Palestinians, who don’t have the weaponry of Israel, the Palestinians
don’t have the financial backing from the United States that Israel has,
and so they throw their rocks and shoot their arrows, and Israel is able
to bomb them and kill them. Watch in the news a disparity between
Palestinians being killed and Israelis being killed. It is totally unfair,
but this country is going to stand on the side of apartheid because that’s
its track record. It stood by apartheid in South Africa, because it
created apartheid in this country.”

Unlike so many AIPAC-backed, establishment Democrats in Congress who
tiptoe around the issue and give mealy-mouthed statements, the Rev. is
committed to:

* Refusing any support from AIPAC or the Israel lobby.
* Condemning the Israeli government’s genocide in Gaza and apartheid in
the West Bank.
* Ending taxpayer-funded U.S. military support for the killing of
Palestinians, and instead redirecting those resources to programs that
will uplift our struggling communities.
* Calling for an arms embargo on Israel and a “Marshall Plan ... to
rebuild Gaza, to rebuild Palestine for the indigenous people.”

But if you have fragile family heirlooms sitting out on shaky tables... they might get knocked over in the excitement. It’s not Trump’s fault. It can create a level of peace and quiet that most retirees never get to feel. | | Dear Friend,

How much do you know about the Electoral College?

A growing movement wants to eliminate it and "move beyond" the Constitution--one reason this issue is vital to our nation's future.

I hope you'll take our **National Quiz on Presidential Selection** today. It's quick, engaging, and helps you better understand how our presidents are elected.

**Take your quiz here:**

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale-college-national-quiz-on-presidential-selection](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zuhv112j3ioriefscvef8dbj6b16qf2vb97j2030_rp22sh2s8i6epr2chi60o76cjh2bs)**

For most of our history, the Electoral College protected free and representative government. But today, dozens of states are working to weaken it--largely because too many schools no longer teach basic civics.

Hillsdale is working to counter this by reaching and teaching millions nationwide.

When you complete the quiz, you'll also receive a free 12-minute video from a Hillsdale professor on the history and purpose of the Electoral College--perfect to share with friends or family.

**Please take the quiz. It will only take a few minutes.**

[https://info.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale-college-national-quiz-on-presidential-selection](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zf976mggnm2e64sp8d7ra7ftk5gprg8ch2tllrr8_rp22sh2s8i6epr2chi60o76cjh2bs)

Hillsdale refuses **all** government funding, so your support is essential. After taking your quiz, please consider a tax-deductible gift of **$35, $50, or $100** to help us share this information with millions of Americans, especially young people.

Thank you for helping safeguard constitutional principles.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

**P.S.** Please share the quiz with a young person who cares about civics.

subject: Senator Reeves Advances Key Legislation in Virginia
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY FRIENDS OF BRYCE REEVES
body:
Discover the nine bipartisan bills making a difference for Virginians.
| | |
---
| | [](https://gkbt4brd.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fbrycereeves.com%2F/1/0100019c99b1bd85-70d6b497-f660-48c2-a5bb-17b25794911e-000000/8W1MVZf4UW0kicpu65gZF_QnmdI=467)
---
| # FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE #
---
| Contact:James Manetz(540) 645-8440James@BryceReeves.com RICHMOND, VA – Today, Senator Bryce Reeves (R - Orange) announced the success of his legislative docket during the first half of Virginia's 60-day legislative session. “I'm proud to say that I have advanced nine bills throught the Senate process and into the House of Delegates. Every one of these bills recieved strong bipartisan support in the Senate and they all seek to rectify a variety of issues across the Commonwealth. I have worked tirelessly alongside constituents, local governments, members of the military, small business owners, and other stakeholders to ensure that we continue to make Virginians' lives easier, better, and safer", said Reeves. “My Republican colleagues and I have been busy fighting against attempts to raise your taxes and restrict your constitutional rights. I've been focused on real issues that affect real people across the state.” Reeves started the 2026 legislative session with an expansive docket of pro-business, pro-military, and pro-family bills, including a [ban on men in women's sports](https://gkbt4brd.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Flis.virginia.gov%2Fbill-details%2F20261%2FSB560/1/0100019c99b1bd85-70d6b497-f660-48c2-a5bb-17b25794911e-000000/lwicWcZY6mnkthX-XxeU5NeDJmY=467) and a [major omnibus bill ](https://gkbt4brd.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Flis.virginia.gov%2Fbill-details%2F20261%2FSB558/1/0100019c99b1bd85-70d6b497-f660-48c2-a5bb-17b25794911e-000000/arGqiLGGDu9h1YO6vbsR1DXO2hk=467)that sought to establish a centralized Virginia Gaming Commission. A number of bills on his original docket were carried over to the 2027 legislative session in order to further study the issues. The bills currently awaiting a hearing in House committees are:
* [SB559 ](https://gkbt4brd.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Flis.virginia.gov%2Fbill-details%2F20261%2FSB559/1/0100019c99b1bd85-70d6b497-f660-48c2-a5bb-17b25794911e-000000/Kcmcc1-_mMA6r6Ogqax9G_7F59E=467)\- An additional tool to allow our Commonwealth's attorneys to go after organized check forging operations.
* [SB573](https://gkbt4brd.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Flis.virginia.gov%2Fbill-details%2F20261%2FSB573/1/0100019c99b1bd85-70d6b497-f660-48c2-a5bb-17b25794911e-000000/LFTmcN_l8dJ-dndJksnxuRtgYRU=467) \- A technical bill supporting Virginia National Guard emergency response vehicles that serve the public.
* [SB574](https://gkbt4brd.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Flis.virginia.gov%2Fbill-details%2F20261%2FSB574/1/0100019c99b1bd85-70d6b497-f660-48c2-a5bb-17b25794911e-000000/TAHhtEZ1fRdQKAjsMUKpsqsX174=467) \- A bill to support the auction industry in Virginia and prevent conflicts of interest in their regulatory body.
* [SB575](https://gkbt4brd.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Flis.virginia.gov%2Fbill-details%2F20261%2FSB575/1/0100019c99b1bd85-70d6b497-f660-48c2-a5bb-17b25794911e-000000/14wkw9RJnWaeW4kZc6_1lzbHmHI=467) \- A bill to support our military bases by allowing base commanders to enter into Intergovernmental Support Agreements with our local governments.
* [SB577](https://gkbt4brd.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Flis.virginia.gov%2Fbill-details%2F20261%2FSB577/1/0100019c99b1bd85-70d6b497-f660-48c2-a5bb-17b25794911e-000000/ZqNWWSGTfTa0kd-l_Z7n1_0iPps=467) \- This bill is intended to ease tensions between property owners and military base leadership across the Commonwealth, and was submitted at the request of the Virginia Military Advisory Council.
* [SB600 ](https://gkbt4brd.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Flis.virginia.gov%2Fbill-details%2F20261%2FSB600/1/0100019c99b1bd85-70d6b497-f660-48c2-a5bb-17b25794911e-000000/XnjqQ9o97WCkmylgXVaX45KuBA0=467)\- This bill would expand VA National Guard Officers' non-judicial disciplinary options, allowing for a meted approach to any necessary disciplinary actions.
* [SB603](https://gkbt4brd.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Flis.virginia.gov%2Fbill-details%2F20261%2FSB603/1/0100019c99b1bd85-70d6b497-f660-48c2-a5bb-17b25794911e-000000/8Fg1avLcgw8g-6zoeIT09MMlKkk=467) \- This piece of legislation would allow school boards to adopt policies allowing community leaders to serve as volunteer life counselors to students. Students would only be able to participate in counseling services with direct parental consent.
* [SB683](https://gkbt4brd.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Flis.virginia.gov%2Fbill-details%2F20261%2FSB683/1/0100019c99b1bd85-70d6b497-f660-48c2-a5bb-17b25794911e-000000/gAI6GPUlTgiVjKYtzhMODqRGssk=467) \- Seeks to protect constituents' access to clean drinking water by clarifying a code section surrounding emergency management of waterworks facilities.
* [SB753](https://gkbt4brd.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Flis.virginia.gov%2Fbill-details%2F20261%2FSB753/1/0100019c99b1bd85-70d6b497-f660-48c2-a5bb-17b25794911e-000000/CE2UeZWrlaM-I_0s13uCHD8Czx8=467) \- This bill would give Virginians civil cause of action if their voice or likeness are copied and monetized, e.g. via deepfake AI technology.

---
| ###
---
| Bryce Reeves is a former Army Ranger and retired Prince William Co. narcotics detective. Reeves is a father, youth sports coach, and missionary. He sits on the Senate's Finance, General Laws and Technology, Rehabilitation and Social Services, and Local Government committees. Reeves serves as Co-Chair of Virginia's General Assembly Military and Veterans Caucus, a member of the Virginia Military Advisory Council, and Co-Chair of the National Conference of State Legislatures' Military and Veterans Affairs Task Force. He currently serves Virginia's 28th Senatorial District, which includes Greene, Madison, Orange, Culpeper, Rappahannock, Fauquier (part), and Spotsylvania (part) counties. Reeves has been a member of the Virginia Senate since 2012, after unseating a 28-year incumbent to represent Virginia's former 17th Senatorial District.

MAGA knows it is headed for major losses if elections remain free and fair. Instead of changing course, it is choosing coercion. Instead of persuasion, it is choosing fear.

In most states, the presence of law enforcement at polling places is tightly regulated--or prohibited entirely--by state law. The authority to stop voter intimidation does not come from Washington. It comes from state courts, and ultimately from state Supreme Courts.
That is why MAGA's long-term strategy has focused on capturing those courts. This is not new. This is the next phase.

## Texans at the State of the Union
Tuesday night's State of the Union address featured several Texans. For the second year in a row, Rep. Al Green (D-Houston) [was removed](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLEOnDAQRL8GOiN7AcMVLtLQXdqUaLEXcGJsZO8dd38fkV9IMxpppNHM-_Wcn-iDj9tPPMjwZ01zpKsEYqY8uxT5oFIuz_u1I-PyyhvlA2eQoIUEAXp26MN37mpnFukeqiajhgGUHNpurHczqHFxDjrVk1tXVO3YU-sAu1ErPS5Ue3OXSQCt4NYG11Uv62gfAzhNqq86Sc5zyg3vxPTBsoZvelNubDrqYHbms1TtjwqmCqbrupq42PvFnVcwnSl49rZUMNkUt0zlthjElomioN9kmZzg_DpOURiZxCv6FMUS0P4RJ6UzkMBMkQWeVETxWxTZRgQt-17X2bjz8iH4ooeqk9uBPvzbxv9H9G3gbwAAAP__BWOOIw) from the House chamber for causing a disruption. As President Trump began to speak, Green stood holding a sign that read, "Black People Aren't Apes!" Several Republicans, including Rep. Troy Nehls of Richmond, tried to rip the sign out of Green's hands. Trump [awarded](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOpCAUhZ9GOwxe_VELim3sZtstDQMXJQExcBlm3n7jvMLfnOYkX875_j22h3LenftfFVDS28btxJo9EmHaTDwpYM7V0VEPRepZ0o4pqA04CMaBgdiMcv6zja2RT26WvkXZTxP0fBrGuT0k4izEMExC20UNyzxqENOifwxwwbUdWydvGAcQPdzZKWvF0856mcAI7H-akaNxFFNHBxK-Vbb-E1-YOh1D6-VBdOVm-NPA2sBaa-1sfN8v7r6B9YrekdO5gZVSCRdLqGM5KTODyvgP-zKZ9TEaljDrgixhOR1hZlqFCxPTUWVie1HJsFxdCJhYjlTaJM1Vnfcui6kZ-R6U899d9DubLwn_AwAA__9QXo57) the Legion of Merit to Scott Ruskan, the Coast Guard rescue swimmer who saved 165 people at Camp Mystic during last summer's deadly flash floods. He was joined by 11-year-old Milly Cate McClymond, one of the girls he helped to safety. ## Don't Mess with Whataburger
A Whataburger in Paris was the site of a chaotic confrontation [caught on video](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO5CAQRL8GZ4ygjQ0OHFzibC-90GpMM0bC9gh6h92_P3mjyy_pDkp6qld_PtYPTDmdz9940Mxf8VpPajUTM5U1XCcfVGtLvLcdGf1neVI5cAUFo1QgYVwDpvy9mi7MXoVJdzRra0Er2xvX7bNWAWHYQBvlKPrJTQatNb0e-omM7bs03zAFMGq47wNjHH1022QhjKQHYRSFxFd58E5MX1hj_r7eVB7bdXR53plfVfS_BCwCltbao0XEOxSwYOG0ZRKw3F4ClnxtmAUsPyD5j5U88MT7e0Kusn7WF20suWDd5YanfKdAl4AFnJXGOReC09LjYKUZjJY-mCiVD-hdoN4Z6socXi3lnOpohVHPA1P-6cz_t_R7hr8BAAD__6ZUkgs) Sunday, when staff used a trash can and a deep-fryer basket to fend off a drunken attacker. Police initially responded to a call about a man who "became verbally abusive" toward staff and was asked to leave. Before 41-year-old Anthony William Newhuis complied, he [threatened to come back](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OrDAMhZ8mdKBgwl-R4jZ0c9stkSEORAoEJd7JzNuvmGYfYBtXn3zOd74e8wOdd-f2Hw_S_LJhPiknT8wUZxNOPiil7HjPOzIu33GjeOAMErpSQgndbND596wKoxdpxrogXfc91LJv1FDsmhaL7dqNRi7j2KpFWmqR1DKgahpqh8Lp-5kE6Gq4b4XWdosd1rEH01HdCiXJOA6x4p2YXpisf4cnxWoNR-H1znwl0fwTMAmYcs7V8U544snhdOGGBEy3lYDJhxW9gAkju9XTzf96ldZtO5cXRpfKT1AJ9ahkq5rq2q8ianNl571LXS-U3A50_tOB_7bcU8NPAAAA__8eE4T5) after officers left. Shortly later, he returned and "assaulted the manager [by] striking him with his fist multiple times." A customer captured the [ensuing brawl](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDFvgzAUhH8NbEbwcOxk8NCFLV07okf8jC0ZHNmvOPn3FZ26dzndcLrTd1_3-Y4hhn39xI0Mv1yad6olEjPl2aadNyqlBvbVI-PynVfKG87QgxI9CFCzxRDfs2ytWXp7G1oyg9Yw9HqU19YbBTCoi5PLop2TGpVypG8jkYIRlL60wZxlPYAa4NQOnVOLuz5uGqyi4dLInmzglDv2xPTC4uI7HZS7R9raaDzzszTjRwNTA1OttXPpJU-MM9DAdNoGpiNkjOIIlpL4QyMKo3PCB-awr2LDXaRdeELbZmOfNcQYitKN7NcNQ_wd5f9ddRj4CQAA__8DKIAV) on video, which has gone viral. Police detained the bloodied Newhuis in the restaurant's parking lot. Before he was released on $4,500 in bonds on Monday, Newhuis was [charged with criminal mischief](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOpDAQRL8Gsh7hZjAQOLhksr30QtTg9mCtsZHdC8vfn7jo8k0qKan06v35mD7IBx_fv2ljI98uTZHPEliE82RTlI1LOb2s50pC81d-c95owgY1NAioJ0s-XNOztmZu7KhqNqrvUTV9-xzq1TjShFbTQFa1qsVx1LbteteOmkftutqbe6xB1ArvfJBzenbDMvZoNauuejZsvaT8kJWFv6m4cKWD82NJWx3MKrKXqv1V4avC185pD3xXFb7-gwbe9pAuZnAcbYHkHGQuQl-ZogCJ0PLJGe6vQODyBTOVTxagaEEylRUWiuAjHD5TgMNbTqDUqNqhwzobu58-BF90Xz2b90Y-_AOUn2k9DP4NAAD__60Zj6M) for allegedly "intentionally" flooding the cells of the Lamar County Jail.
## Apple Expanding Houston Manufacturing Site
Apple's Houston factory for manufacturing AI servers will [begin producing](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOszAQhJ_GdEZm8W-HwsXf0OXaK9GC18GSjRHehOTtT9wrXDMaaUafRvN9n-4YU9weX5jJ8TuUaaOzJmKmY_Jl40y1npHXc0XG-Xk86Mg4gQIjFUgwk8eYPpNuvJuVH7qGXGctdMr2-tasznTW9HrRYbAdarRzry2F4TYThgEH20R3wRSA6eDSFkMwc7gtgwVvqPsntCIfuRwtr8T0xhrSp7zoaJeSm-RW5r2K_r-AUcB4nme7bPNyhQLGiy1gVHB5LWDEfU8kuchcXiRrySQzLjLHLcr9KP65cCzbVXhWGTd5AdqVc2oO5_czphSrsUKrR8aYfifw3457OfgJAAD__1GogbQ) the Mac Mini, its compact desktop computer, creating "thousands of jobs." | | Friends and fellow Republicans,
Thank you for gathering tonight and for the work you do as precinct delegates. I regret that I cannot attend as many county conventions as I would like this evening, but please know how grateful I am for your time, your commitment, and your service to our party and our state.
The past seven months have been among the most meaningful of my life. Since launching this campaign, I have traveled to 69 counties, attended more than 200 campaign events, and, with the help of dedicated volunteers, made over 6,000 calls directly to delegates like you. We have logged more than 40,000 miles crisscrossing Michigan, meeting people where they are and listening to their concerns about the future of our state.
Along the way, I have been humbled by the broad support this campaign has earned across Michigan, including county prosecutors, law enforcement leaders, grassroots activists, and Republican leaders from every corner of the state. That support is not about politics for its own sake. It is about restoring integrity, accountability, and the rule of law to the Office of Attorney General.
Following tonight's county conventions, our focus turns to March 28. I will continue to show up, listen, and do the work necessary to earn your trust and your vote. I welcome your calls, your questions, and your feedback, and I encourage you to reach out at any time.
This campaign is about restoring law and order, upholding the Constitution, protecting Michigan's sovereignty, and putting Michigan and Michiganders first. It is also about winning in November and defeating the Democrats so we can stop political games and return the Attorney General's Office to its proper role.
This next month will be busy, but together we can win. I humbly ask for your support and your help as we work to take Michigan back.
Thank you again for all you do. I look forward to seeing you on the trail very soon.
Sincerely,
Doug Lloyd Eaton County Prosecuting Attorney Candidate for Michigan Attorney General

# **The 2026 "Trump Effect"
on IRAs over $50,000**
---
**President Trump’s “One Big Beautiful Bill” is exactly what this country needs.** It’s big, it’s bold, and it’s finally putting American families first. But we have to be honest with you about something that’s hard to say. **Trump’s new plan is moving fast** ... maybe too fast for the old, fragile banking system to handle. Think of it like a powerful cleaning crew coming into a dusty old house. They are going to scrub everything clean, which is wonderful. But if you have fragile family heirlooms sitting out on shaky tables... they might get knocked over in the excitement. It’s not Trump’s fault. He is doing his job. **But the Wall Street banks holding your retirement savings are like those shaky tables.** They are old, tired, and not built for this kind of _**Economic Revolution**._ If you leave your money sitting there, it could get caught in the shake-up.
---
**This is why we hesitate to share this next part publicly.**
---
There is a way to move your **_financial heirloom_** to a safe room before the cleaning starts. It involves a specific, IRS-approved loophole that very few families know about. **To be honest, this loophole works so well it may feel a little unfair**. It allows you to quietly step out of the chaotic banking system to figuratively _**lock** _your savings into something that doesn't care about stock markets or bank failures. It can create a level of peace and quiet that most retirees never get to feel. While your neighbors are glued to the TV worrying about the next market swing, you can turn the TV off, knowing your grandkid's inheritance is sitting in a sanctuary that Wall Street can't touch.
---
# **[We’ve written down exactly how to use this loophole inside our 2026 Patriot’s Wealth Defense Guide.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D)**
---
This kind of protection is typically only whispered about by the ultra-wealthy. But with the speed of Trump's changes, we feel a moral duty to share it with those who need to help protect their families. **If you are an American Citizen with more than $50,000 in retirement, you may already be eligible to receive the benefits detailed in this free guide.** [**Note: We also currently have a Silver Allocation Incentive*.**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D) Qualified accounts may be eligible for up to $10,000 in additional physical silver to jumpstart the hedge.

| The State of The Union and My response to Governor Spanberger
---
|
---
Team,

It was a privilege to represent the amazing people of Virginia's 5th District at my first State of the Union address. [President Donald J. Trump](https://eky6fg9ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001_CT9YYC8nILPwgQKpvhNLbsIub7r6j4P-Xda5FfO57kd75p4BCgrGzq50WEbN6oSRDGED9F0K6SDX0A3WZilN4dbBujNqr-aNkWT5SLnvBPM-ytSqdtFoSxPbROlXWTjpgze4VO5U8K1-axNedXJGrEcTsxlp0oXAxFYIdn3EGSXCOb5fVNEAf5iPW8WomL0aQz1lbLvNfnFhmvcP8bRInjVh7zOQfvTT-auEWZ2n13rDZqS7W-sHWCik1fgxML5MdAFJZwSjSvnxmVp06MKWtyuRsNAUWxpWWUKfsVsG-jOHKbxUf7cKsyGuFStHtl1jj174_ktaZF6HNfSnQJIvbFyi-7VfMApDEba_zouVDCUDXWGwdNAIctz94R3BZbn8qn0aJCoaFYQjbOpcJBYB74k5hcrcKPtGdTF3G6hv9soKJuCsEk1QGYZuDw6eYG4&c=lvS0w_1vzm9TcQ7rT-lVGB6wTNs8EtsiEDZ0RgA-yGtUtxZk68a0_Q==&ch=he4427uiiz6haDPYIH4vq1e1CrcQCsjdkA-i8T5I3o-2U9qpPBn5zA==)'s speech was a testament to the strength of our nation and a bold roadmap for a safer, more affordable America. I am grateful for President Donald J. Trump's leadership and his dedication to the American worker. His efforts are improving life for all Americans.
While the evening was a celebration of American potential, I was struck by the stark contrasts in the room. I was surprised to see the Democratic Party cheer at the prospect of raising taxes on hardworking families. Furthermore, it was deeply troubling to see a lack of across-the-board support when the President honored the mother of Iryna Zarutska, who tragically lost her life in a horrific subway stabbing. These are moments that should transcend politics. It was a very inspiring and historic moment to celebrate the USA Men's Hockey Team for winning Olympic gold, and I loved seeing everyone on the floor chant, "USA, USA, USA!"
On a similarly inspiring note, the chamber was united in pride as we recognized our veterans, including a recipient of the Purple Heart and two men receiving the Medal of Honor. God bless America!
Seven Key Policy Highlights from the 2026 Address:
* Economic Recovery: Highlighting historic drops in inflation and celebrating record-high markets.
* Border Enforcement: Implementing stricter laws with a renewed focus on a "zero illegal entry" standard.
* Prescription Drugs: Substantially lowering costs through the Most Favored Nation policy.
* Family Savings: Applauding "Trump Accounts" for children and new retirement contribution matches.
* Global Security: Ending eight international conflicts and reasserting American leadership abroad.
* Military Strength: Prioritizing the modernization of our armed forces and celebrating record-breaking recruitment numbers to ensure our national defense remains the strongest in the world. No more men in dresses.
* Election Integrity: Working to secure elections through the Save America Act, which requires proof of U.S. citizenship to register to vote and photo ID to cast a ballot.

[](https://substack.com/redirect/8f225f3d-a6d8-493a-8866-5fbab48d0a7e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
In this interview Ohio Secretary of State candidate and former House Minority Leader Allison Russo outlines her background in public health policy, her experience flipping a Republican-held state House seat, and her leadership during Ohio's contentious redistricting battles. She explains the core responsibilities of the Secretary of State as Ohio's chief elections officer, emphasizing election administration, collaboration with county boards of elections, and advocacy for voters. A central theme of the discussion is restoring public trust in elections through transparency, consistency, and resisting political interference at both the state and federal levels. Russo criticizes recent decisions to withdraw Ohio from the ERIC voter data-sharing system and raises concerns about voter roll maintenance practices, arguing they have created confusion and unnecessary barriers.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/be825cfa-ebe1-4efa-af41-f6c02287aedc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The conversation also covers the federal SAVE Act, which Russo describes as a restrictive voter registration measure rather than a simple voter ID bill, warning it would impose documentation and in-person requirements that could disenfranchise eligible voters. She defends her role in negotiating legislative district maps in 2023, framing the decision as strategic harm reduction that preserved key procedural tools like the citizen referendum. Additional topics include navigating a Republican supermajority, the importance of bipartisan and interstate cooperation among Secretaries of State, improving voter access and education, strengthening Democratic Party engagement through competitive primaries, and modernizing Ohio's election infrastructure, including campaign finance transparency and county-level election website consistency.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f528c2c1-5d5f-4d87-87b3-ed04074f9bdd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* * *
[](https://substack.com/redirect/f378f3ed-cf28-413c-b3a6-d789d4180107?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
In this interview Dr. Bryan Hambley, a leukemia physician from Cincinnati and Democratic candidate for Ohio Secretary of State, outlines his platform centered on election integrity, anti-gerrymandering reform, and restoring public trust in democracy. He emphasizes three core responsibilities of the office: oversight of redistricting and ballot language, administration of elections, and maintenance of voter rolls. Hambley sharply criticizes the current Secretary of State's handling of ballot language, withdrawal from the ERIC voter data-sharing system, and partisan voter roll purges, arguing these actions undermine public confidence. He states that he would refuse to certify an invalid election only under lawful circumstances and insists the role should be exercised independently of partisan pressure.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/968a5be2-4bcb-483e-bd0d-1a04fd428343?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
A central theme of the discussion is gerrymandering, which Hambley describes as the "upstream problem" distorting Ohio politics and limiting policy progress, including healthcare reform. He calls for a renewed constitutional amendment to establish an independent redistricting commission and pledges to support honest ballot language. Hambley also advocates for expanded ballot access, local control over drop boxes, nonpartisan voter roll maintenance, and stronger campaign finance transparency, including rejecting corporate PAC money. Broadening the conversation, he critiques careerism in politics, urges Democrats to communicate more clearly about values and universal healthcare, and argues that rebuilding voter trust requires authentic engagement across all communities. He concludes on an optimistic note about Democratic competitiveness in 2026, emphasizing grassroots organizing and statewide outreach.

## Trump Unveils Retirement Savings Plan
President Trump announced [a new retirement savings plan](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGSozAQRU8DmSipwYADBZuQedMNqTZqTO8ISSU1Znz7KU8yB5j813_13r_bfEP2HB5_cScra5wDncWTCOU5k3CmnYKkHFMs6O9UZItlBg290qCgnx2yf81d7exKBNTWZM0wgDHtaEy92avGEXvU0MFwddr16KCn9XrHZQDsxprt-00D9Ka9aD02l3HpSJtRu65FN1LVaXIsMTf_IwfZaPWv-KTcLHGvvd1EUqnaPxVMFUzneTZr_LwfhQOV8t5UMKXoWXgpFUySjz2pIzyJfVE_iip5DOpIynyolRxl9GpHWbY6W5dO9p5LP1SdfuzI_pstvwr2tPAVAAD__xoXgp4) during his State of the Union address that would create new retirement accounts for American workers who lack employer-sponsored plans, with federal matching contributions of up to $1,000 per year. Roughly 56 million Americans currently [lack access to a workplace retirement plan](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGupDAQRE8DmZHdGPAEDjYhm003RAaawbvGbdnNoLn9ip_8A_yspJKe6tWf5_R0Pvj4-u0OtLzRFPEqAZkxTxnZZzwwcsqUqLgwY-GdygQSeiFBQD-tzofPpOvVboiAbY1WDQMo1Rql6t2i3jqjetDwGNQyu7l7aNObbR1gcEbNtbc3TQL0qu2kNE1nFo1SGbnq1q0GKy1x9Uy5-Us-8o5b-NAbc7PQUQe7M6dStb8qGCsYr-tqlrncFndfwXjHCkbO55HEt5Jwy0JnZFHYMQraBO8ozugpio2ySEgpoLg873Sy0FL9uzF1tmu6fAi-9EOl5etwPnwt4R_d97bwPwAA__9664Zn). The new accounts would be modeled on the Thrift Savings Plan used by federal employees, offering low-fee index fund options and portability between jobs. The proposal builds on the SECURE 2.0 Act, which already includes a Saver's Match provision set to take effect in 2027. That program offers eligible lower-income workers a 50% government match on up to $2,000 in annual contributions. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the proposal would be rolled out “in the coming weeks and months,” framing the initiative as [a tool to help working Americans](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u4yAQRp8Gd45g_IcLim3cZdstLWzGYVZjsGA2Ud5-ldvcB7j1J31H5_y5r3dPTOnx25_o5MhrwldlFMGyFhQqeGKSq-QrV88bVom5rqBhbDW0MK7BE7_XvgnuQATsGnRmmsCYzhrTRBe8nfEwx9FZPQ-HGTacJ7TB4jzaad8acp83DTCabtDa3ga796iN1aHvfLCoeo2BJJfb30xJIh78zk8stz2fDbsoclXV_VKwKFgkYiTmz6ZguTLT_lawRPQscfcFFSzDNPQw2XbDWjFJK-XfebXftu3FPtW24J7TTkxeKCcFS1NcuF7ETHWcVK8fp6cvUiM_Svd08D8AAP__qX-E_Q) “who have been left behind.”
## Pentagon Sets Deadline for AI Military Access
Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth gave Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei [a Friday deadline](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOpCAUhZ8GOwxcUJmCYhu72XZLg3Ad2KAYuDNm3n7jvsLfneQk5-T7_jyXp0s5Ha_fbkdLW1kOvFpGIqxLRUoVdzzorOUszeUVG8XSFhAwcgEcxiW4lL-L7oLdEAFVh1ZOE0ipjJRdtBqlNAbUoGEY18eqwzQ9BmVgXREeAbpk7zUBMEo1CGH6wXiNQhoRtHLBINMCQ6JS-78lHRRxy9_ywdr7snfZRqKzMfWLwcxgvq6r92u7Ke6ewXxHBnPEV0OK3B0UazmT59s7Z-68x9a4z-4dkLvE9xIwM5i7asN5pZxTGyemxWt3Kf-_pB95-lj4FwAA__8fZX1W) to grant the military unrestricted access to its AI model, Claude, or face termination of the company's $200 million Pentagon contract. Anthropic has [insisted on guardrails](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGu4yAQRb_G7ohgjI0bim3cvW23tCYwCbPCYMG8WPn7VfYXXnl1pat7zp-v_Qs5c3n-xoO8POpe6OqZRKjtjYQbHVTkbPWsHfOduqTad9CwKA0Klj0i5_dux-gfREDTSN44B8ZMqzFj8to6p8O8OmsnExHvDnGi4IzGOcAaRvafNQ2wmGnWer3Na7CkzaqjnTCuNFhNkaW229_KRRI98ru-qN1CPcbsk8jZh-nXANsA23Vdt3IPH4pPP8AmFNIAW6fw3VjeA2xYJLV6clAnFcFnLeq7q4MzC7a3CvjJpJDVwb1zJhXpQaWTSvTsJEm1UBAWPU92bD6eF-fMfXGD1c8DOf9_Jj_S-fLwLwAA__81gYw3) preventing Claude from being used for mass surveillance of Americans or in lethal autonomous weapons systems without human oversight. The company argues the technology is not reliable enough for life-or-death decisions. Pentagon officials warned they could invoke the Defense Production Act to compel compliance or designate Anthropic a "supply chain risk," effectively blacklisting the company from government work. They refill us for the work, the parenting, the protecting, and the showing up again tomorrow.

He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. name: Lucy Trainor
subject: Please Support My Husband Trey in TX-21
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Trey Trainor for Texas
body:
As Trey's wife and mom to our six kids, I've seen his heart for Texas and President Trump's agenda firsthand. Your support means the world!

| | | | | [|
---](https://Trey4TX.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=8131ec3633&e=4d3fe76c62)
| | Peter,
My name is Lucy Trainor, and I'm writing to you as Trey's wife and the mother of our six wonderful children. As we approach the **March 3, 2026 Republican Primary** in Texas’ 21st Congressional District, I wanted to share why I believe Trey is the right person to represent the Hill Country and the conservative values we hold dear.
**Trey has always put principle and country first, even when it cost our family.** When President Trump appointed him to serve as a Commissioner, and later Chairman, of the Federal Election Commission in 2020, Trey accepted without hesitation. It was a tremendous honor to defend election integrity at the highest level, but it also meant a significant pay cut from his private law practice. Our family budget felt that impact for years. We supported the decision fully because the future of our country and the fairness of our elections matter far more than personal comfort.
During those years, we also faced two separate Inspector General investigations, both of which were resolved in Trey's favor but brought real stress to our lives. The first came after Trey spoke at a bipartisan election integrity event in Denton County. The sponsors mistakenly billed him as a “Trump Campaign” representative instead of listing his official FEC role, triggering scrutiny. The second investigation arose when Trey respectfully declined the COVID vaccine mandate for federal workers under President Biden. **He stood on principle, and we stood with him.**
Through it all, **Trey represented the United States with integrity** on international election monitoring missions in Costa Rica and Romania. Romania was especially meaningful. Amid global attention to election interference and foreign influence there, Trey helped ensure transparency and fairness in the process. I've been incredibly proud to watch him serve our country in these ways.
Our six children, James, Abigail, Patrick, Mary Catherine, Charles, and Andrew, are fully on board with their dad serving in Congress, even though it will mean more time away from home. They understand the stakes: **preserving our freedoms, securing our borders, protecting our elections, and defending the values that make Texas and America strong.** They've seen their father's courage and commitment firsthand, and they're ready to support him.
I would be remiss if I didn't express our deepest gratitude to our friends at St. Martin de Porres Catholic Church and our larger faith community. Your prayers, encouragement, and support have carried us through every trial and triumph. We are truly blessed.
**Trey is a proven fighter who has already sacrificed for our country and our principles.** In Congress, he will stand boldly for secure borders, fiscal responsibility, election integrity, life, the Second Amendment, and America First policies, without apology and without backing down.
I humbly ask you to join our family in supporting **Trey Trainor for Congress in TX-21**. Your vote in the March primary will help send a principled, courageous conservative to Washington who will fight for the Texas Hill Country and for all of us.
Please visit [**www.trey4tx.com**](https://Trey4TX.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=3a076ef323&e=4d3fe76c62) to learn more, [**volunteer**](https://Trey4TX.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=dc4fcb6907&e=4d3fe76c62) , or [contribute](https://Trey4TX.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=988d200913&e=4d3fe76c62). Together, we can win this seat and make a real difference.
With gratitude and hope,
**Lucy Trainor** Wife of TreyMother of James, Abigail, Patrick,Mary Catherine, Charles, & Andrew

Hey there,
While Nevada families struggle with rising costs, Republicans are spending their energy on building new barriers to voting instead of fixing affordability.
Families are forced to choose between rent, medicine, and groceries — that is the crisis voters want addressed. Instead of passing real solutions that lower everyday costs, Republicans want to make it harder for people to vote in the midterms.
**We can fight both for economic relief and for the right to vote.**

name: Justin Streiff, Turning Point USA
subject: ANTIFA tried to shut it all down
body:
Please read the message below from our sponsor.
* * *
| | | [](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tb2moi&__onlt=h)
---
Friend, They tried to break us. At UC Berkeley — one of the most hostile, left-wing campuses in America — ANTIFA tried to shut down our final campus tour stop of 2025. They showed up hours early. Wearing masks. Lighting flares and smoke bombs. Throwing paint and glass bottles at attendees. Waving Mexican and rainbow flags. They mocked Charlie's assassination... pointing to their own necks where he was shot. They chanted: _"F*** Charlie Kirk"... "No safe space for fascist scum"... "Fascists out of Berkeley."_ And they rushed police barricades, hoping to break through and disrupt our final campus tour stop of the semester.
---
[](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tb2moi&__onlt=h)
---
ANTIFA surrounded the venue, blocking every entrance. Even after our students and attendees were leaving, ANTIFA located their exit and continued to meet them with violence. The mob swarmed every student, speaker, and parent who came to hear a message of faith, family, and freedom. A mother holding her two daughters was forced to push through a wall of protesters screaming profanity in her children's faces. Another attendee, blood dripping from his brow, was pulled to safety after being struck in the chaos outside the event. These out-of-control Leftists weren't satisfied with merely being heard in protest — _They wanted to pick a fight._ Police made multiple arrests. **UC Berkeley, a so-called "bastion" of free speech, turned into a war zone.**
---
| | [](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tb2moi&__onlt=h)
---
But still... The event went on. A packed house. Our students didn't retreat. They stood strong. Even when ANTIFA plotted to register for tickets to leave HUNDREDS of empty seats, our patriotic students filled the room anyways. And they gave Charlie's legacy the tribute it deserved. Rob Schneider took the stage with humility and fire. Dr. Frank Turek brought clarity and conviction. What took place behind those doors was a powerful reminder: **Truth is louder than hate.**
---
[](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tb2moi&__onlt=h)
---
| | **Friend, I need you to hear this next part — because it's about patriots like you.** This tour? This fight? These students who keep showing up — even when it's dangerous? They didn't get here on their own. They got here because patriots like YOU believed in them. Because when the mobs swarmed... When the threats came in... When everyone from the fake news media to the so-called political "experts" said Gen Z was lost to the Left... And when they tried to silence this movement that Charlie built... People like you stood up. Stayed in. Kept the mission alive. And showed our young people that they're not alone. That America is still worth fighting for. That free speech still has defenders. That faith, family, and FREEDOM still have a future. So if you've ever wondered if it's working... If it's worth it... **Let me be clear: Patriots like you are why we're winning the American Culture War.** And now this is your chance to be part of something rare — a moment in history where patriotic young Americans are reclaiming the culture, one campus at a time. Our students on campus are truly the vanguard for saving this nation, but they need to know we have their backs. **Will you make a gift right now to send backup to the frontlines and stand with these young patriots who refuse to quit?** **[Every dollar you give today helps us protect our student leaders, send activism kits to chapters, defend free speech, and fuel our reach to change more hearts and minds.](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tb2moi&__onlt=h)**
---
[ **Send Backup to the Frontlines**
**Make Your Gift Here**](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tb2moi&__onlt=h)
---
The Left tried to intimidate us. They tried to outnumber us. They tried to drown us out. But we didn't blink. Our students didn't blink. The mob at Berkeley couldn't stop us. _Because we didn't come to Berkeley to be liked..._ **We came to speak truth.** We came to finish what Charlie started. That's exactly what happened. **And that's exactly why we're winning.** Friend, thank you. Patriots like you helped turn chaos into courage... Hate into hope... And grief into grit. Let's keep going...
---
| | **For Charlie,** **Justin Streiff**
Chief Operating Officer
Turning Point USA

Help these brave young leaders fight for freedom and equip our student chapters across the country.**](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tb2moi&__onlt=h)

Team, Last weekend was a major milestone for our campaign. We hit our **60th stop** on the trail, and the energy we’re seeing across the state is undeniable. From speaking to incredible women in Murfreesboro to firing up the next generation with College Dems at MTSU to visiting counties we hadn’t reached yet— _it’s clear that something is shifting in Tennessee_. Everywhere we go, we hear the same thing: **people are ready for a government that actually sees them.** We're building a coalition of teachers, nurses, veterans, working parents, young people, and small business owners—everyday Tennesseans who are tired of being ignored by a government that serves only the powerful and well-connected. **We’re done settling for cruelty disguised as policy and corruption disguised as leadership.** Together, we’re not just going to shake things up—we’re going to take out the trash and build a Tennessee that works for all of us. **_We aren't slowing down for a second_**.
