name: Justin Streiff, Turning Point USA
subject: ANTIFA tried to break us at Berkeley...
body:
[Mark as Spam](https://trk.americanmediawatchdog.com/?xul=6zs1j7t5dhe4avz97uxx7mw1uqnifalp76lc994qq3xzdthfmr69thdywig0xfxzhg2fp7lc1sw6fs38o6mc1yckrqikuvrx9uptmpr0b420egtp93&__stmp=tb2n2m&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh) | [Unsubscribe](https://trk.americanmediawatchdog.com/?xul=6zs1j7t5dhe4avz97uxx7mw1uqnifalp76lc994qq3xzdthfmr69thdywig0xfxzhg2fp7lc1sw6fs38o6mc1yckrqikuvrx9uptmpr0b420egtp93&__stmp=tb2n2m&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh)
Please read the message below from our sponsor.
* * *
| | | [](https://trk.americanmediawatchdog.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tb2n2m&__onlt=h)
---
Friend, They tried to break us. At UC Berkeley — one of the most hostile, left-wing campuses in America — ANTIFA tried to shut down our final campus tour stop of 2025. They showed up hours early. Wearing masks. Lighting flares and smoke bombs. Throwing paint and glass bottles at attendees. Waving Mexican and rainbow flags. They mocked Charlie's assassination... pointing to their own necks where he was shot. They chanted: _"F*** Charlie Kirk"... "No safe space for fascist scum"... "Fascists out of Berkeley."_ And they rushed police barricades, hoping to break through and disrupt our final campus tour stop of the semester.
---
[](https://trk.americanmediawatchdog.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tb2n2m&__onlt=h)
---
ANTIFA surrounded the venue, blocking every entrance. Even after our students and attendees were leaving, ANTIFA located their exit and continued to meet them with violence. The mob swarmed every student, speaker, and parent who came to hear a message of faith, family, and freedom. A mother holding her two daughters was forced to push through a wall of protesters screaming profanity in her children's faces. Another attendee, blood dripping from his brow, was pulled to safety after being struck in the chaos outside the event. These out-of-control Leftists weren't satisfied with merely being heard in protest — _They wanted to pick a fight._ Police made multiple arrests. **UC Berkeley, a so-called "bastion" of free speech, turned into a war zone.**
---
| | [](https://trk.americanmediawatchdog.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tb2n2m&__onlt=h)
---
But still... The event went on. A packed house. Our students didn't retreat. They stood strong. Even when ANTIFA plotted to register for tickets to leave HUNDREDS of empty seats, our patriotic students filled the room anyways. And they gave Charlie's legacy the tribute it deserved. Rob Schneider took the stage with humility and fire. Dr. Frank Turek brought clarity and conviction. What took place behind those doors was a powerful reminder: **Truth is louder than hate.**
---
[](https://trk.americanmediawatchdog.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tb2n2m&__onlt=h)
---
| | **Friend, I need you to hear this next part — because it's about patriots like you.** This tour? This fight? These students who keep showing up — even when it's dangerous? They didn't get here on their own. They got here because patriots like YOU believed in them. Because when the mobs swarmed... When the threats came in... When everyone from the fake news media to the so-called political "experts" said Gen Z was lost to the Left... And when they tried to silence this movement that Charlie built... People like you stood up. Stayed in. Kept the mission alive. And showed our young people that they're not alone. That America is still worth fighting for. That free speech still has defenders. That faith, family, and FREEDOM still have a future. So if you've ever wondered if it's working... If it's worth it... **Let me be clear: Patriots like you are why we're winning the American Culture War.** And now this is your chance to be part of something rare — a moment in history where patriotic young Americans are reclaiming the culture, one campus at a time. Our students on campus are truly the vanguard for saving this nation, but they need to know we have their backs. **Will you make a gift right now to send backup to the frontlines and stand with these young patriots who refuse to quit?** **[Every dollar you give today helps us protect our student leaders, send activism kits to chapters, defend free speech, and fuel our reach to change more hearts and minds.](https://trk.americanmediawatchdog.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tb2n2m&__onlt=h)**
---
[ **Send Backup to the Frontlines**
**Make Your Gift Here**](https://trk.americanmediawatchdog.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tb2n2m&__onlt=h)
---
The Left tried to intimidate us. They tried to outnumber us. They tried to drown us out. But we didn't blink. Our students didn't blink. The mob at Berkeley couldn't stop us. _Because we didn't come to Berkeley to be liked..._ **We came to speak truth.** We came to finish what Charlie started. That's exactly what happened. **And that's exactly why we're winning.** Friend, thank you. Patriots like you helped turn chaos into courage... Hate into hope... And grief into grit. Let's keep going...
---
| | **For Charlie,** **Justin Streiff**
Chief Operating Officer
Turning Point USA

A new statewide [poll](https://substack.com/redirect/26ae38f5-b4f2-4f61-9444-ff8671027d82?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of Maine voters shows broad support for requiring proof of U.S. citizenship to register to vote in federal elections -- and strong backing for the SAVE America Act, a proposal now before Congress.
The debate over illegal alien and non-citizen voting looms large over Maine's upcoming 2026 elections, especially considering Secretary of State Shenna Bellows (D) has famously admitted that non-citizens are registered to vote in Maine.
The SAVE Act could also play in the all-important Maine Senate race.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/3046762b-30bc-4dd1-948c-7acaca7f768b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)| | |
#### [Maine Secretary of State Admits Non-Citizens Registered to Vote](https://substack.com/redirect/3046762b-30bc-4dd1-948c-7acaca7f768b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---
| | [The Robinson Report](https://substack.com/profile/147548156-the-robinson-report)| | *

| August 29, 2025
| [| Read full story
---](https://substack.com/redirect/3046762b-30bc-4dd1-948c-7acaca7f768b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Incumbent Republican U.S. Sen. Susan Collins has [broadcast](https://substack.com/redirect/b3129126-d7fe-4ba7-9037-42a228012ca2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) her support for protecting America's elections from noncitizen voters.
Maine Democrats have largely opposed new election integrity measures.
The poll suggests the issue could carry political consequences for Maine's high-profile U.S. Senate election.
Join 26.5k Mainers who get their news and political content from the best Substack in Maine!
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..rsSk3HHGVc6jVnqe0or5QwQ-1DlTBO1WgNbq0_mt__4?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=189258263)
Democratic Gov. Janet Mills and upstart progressive radical Graham Platner have both staked their flags squarely in favor of non-citizen voting.
Mills has called the SAVE Act a "dangerous Trump-backed voter suppression bill" that would disenfranchise voters, though she's offered no evidence to support the claim.
Platner has called the SAVE Act a "terrible" bill and said Republicans "only chance to stay in office" is to implement ID and citizenship checks for elections.
The survey is good news for Collins, showing that Maine voters back enforceable prohibitions on the kind of non-citizen voting even Bellows admits is happening.
According to the survey of 604 likely Maine voters conducted Feb. 13-16, 63% said they support the SAVE America Act, which would require proof of citizenship to register and a valid ID to cast a ballot in federal elections, while 26% oppose it.
The poll, commissioned and paid for by conservative Heritage Action and directed by Stefani Buhajla in partnership with Cor Strategies, LLC, has a margin of sampling error of plus or minus 3.99 percentage points.
When asked directly whether they support requiring proof of U.S. citizenship to register to vote in federal elections, 65% of all voters said they support the requirement, compared with 20% who oppose it .
Support is strongest among Republicans at 88%, but a majority of independents -- 62% -- also back the requirement. Among Democrats, 48% -- almost a majority -- support it, while 34% oppose it .
The poll also found that 73% of Maine voters say noncitizens should not be allowed to vote in U.S. elections, compared with 17% who say they should be allowed .
In another question, 69% of respondents said they support requiring states to remove noncitizens from voter registration rolls, while 16% oppose the idea .
And 67% favor imposing civil penalties on election officials who knowingly register noncitizens to vote, compared with 15% who oppose such penalties .
Support for the SAVE America Act appears to increase when national security is invoked.
When voters were told the legislation could improve national security by preventing foreign adversaries such as China from interfering in U.S. elections, 49% said they would be "much more likely" to support it and 20% said "somewhat more likely" -- a combined 69% saying they would be more inclined to back the measure.
Just 16% said they would be less likely to support it under that framing.
The survey also tested broader statements about election integrity.

Eighty percent of voters either strongly or somewhat agree that "every legal voter should have confidence that their vote is counted equally and not diluted by ineligible ballots," including 61% who strongly agree.
Similarly, 78% either strongly or somewhat agree that every state should be held to the same standard when it comes to who is eligible to vote in federal elections.
Seventy-one percent agree that clear verification requirements discourage fraud before it happens.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/b3129126-d7fe-4ba7-9037-42a228012ca2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)| | |
#### [EXCLUSIVE: Susan Collins Backs SAVE AMERICA ACT -- But Won't Break Filibuster ](https://substack.com/redirect/b3129126-d7fe-4ba7-9037-42a228012ca2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

The big picture take away is a super majority of Maine voters support Collins position and oppose Democrats when it comes to the SAVE Act.
Asked whether they would be more likely to support re-election of their senators if they voted in favor of the SAVE America Act, 36% said "much more likely" and 19% said "somewhat more likely," for a combined 55% saying a vote for the bill would make them more inclined to back their senators.
Twenty-nine percent said they would be less likely to support re-election under those circumstances.
The survey sample included 31% Republicans, 33% independents and 36% Democrats. Forty percent of respondents were 65 or older, and the gender split was evenly divided between men and women.
The question over citizenship requirements for elections comes as Secretary Bellows, after admitting on camera that non-citizens are registered to vote, has refused to cooperate with a U.S. Department of Justice investigation into Maine's voter rolls.

Susan Collins (R-Maine), remains wildly popular with Maine voters. Democrats Janet Mills and Graham Platner oppose the ban on noncitizen voting. Feb 26 | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- A new statewide of Maine voters shows broad support for requiring proof of U.S. citizenship to register to vote in federal elections -- and strong backing for the SAVE America Act, a proposal now before Congress. The debate over illegal alien and non-citizen voting looms large over Maine's upcoming 2026 elections, especially considering Secretary of State Shenna Bellows (D) has famously admitted that non-citizens are registered to vote in Maine. The SAVE Act could also play in the all-important Maine Senate race. | | | | | | | ---|---|--- | August 29, 2025 | Incumbent Republican U.S. Sen. Susan Collins has her support for protecting America's elections from noncitizen voters. Maine Democrats have largely opposed new election integrity measures. The poll suggests the issue could carry political consequences for Maine's high-profile U.S. Senate election. Join 26.5k Mainers who get their news and political content from the best Substack in Maine! Democratic Gov. Janet Mills and upstart progressive radical Graham Platner have both staked their flags squarely in favor of non-citizen voting. Mills has called the SAVE Act a "dangerous Trump-backed voter suppression bill" that would disenfranchise voters, though she's offered no evidence to support the claim. Platner has called the SAVE Act a "terrible" bill and said Republicans "only chance to stay in office" is to implement ID and citizenship checks for elections. The survey is good news for Collins, showing that Maine voters back enforceable prohibitions on the kind of non-citizen voting even Bellows admits is happening. According to the survey of 604 likely Maine voters conducted Feb. 13-16, 63% said they support the SAVE America Act, which would require proof of citizenship to register and a valid ID to cast a ballot in federal elections, while 26% oppose it. The poll, commissioned and paid for by conservative Heritage Action and directed by Stefani Buhajla in partnership with Cor Strategies, LLC, has a margin of sampling error of plus or minus 3.99 percentage points. When asked directly whether they support requiring proof of U.S. citizenship to register to vote in federal elections, 65% of all voters said they support the requirement, compared with 20% who oppose it . Support is strongest among Republicans at 88%, but a majority of independents -- 62% -- also back the requirement. Among Democrats, 48% -- almost a majority -- support it, while 34% oppose it . The poll also found that 73% of Maine voters say noncitizens should not be allowed to vote in U.S. elections, compared with 17% who say they should be allowed . In another question, 69% of respondents said they support requiring states to remove noncitizens from voter registration rolls, while 16% oppose the idea . And 67% favor imposing civil penalties on election officials who knowingly register noncitizens to vote, compared with 15% who oppose such penalties . Support for the SAVE America Act appears to increase when national security is invoked. When voters were told the legislation could improve national security by preventing foreign adversaries such as China from interfering in U.S. elections, 49% said they would be "much more likely" to support it and 20% said "somewhat more likely" -- a combined 69% saying they would be more inclined to back the measure. Just 16% said they would be less likely to support it under that framing. The survey also tested broader statements about election integrity. ? Eighty percent of voters either strongly or somewhat agree that "every legal voter should have confidence that their vote is counted equally and not diluted by ineligible ballots," including 61% who strongly agree. Similarly, 78% either strongly or somewhat agree that every state should be held to the same standard when it comes to who is eligible to vote in federal elections. Seventy-one percent agree that clear verification requirements discourage fraud before it happens. | | | | | | | ---|---|--- | Feb 13 | The big picture take away is a super majority of Maine voters support Collins position and oppose Democrats when it comes to the SAVE Act. Asked whether they would be more likely to support re-election of their senators if they voted in favor of the SAVE America Act, 36% said "much more likely" and 19% said "somewhat more likely," for a combined 55% saying a vote for the bill would make them more inclined to back their senators. Twenty-nine percent said they would be less likely to support re-election under those circumstances. The survey sample included 31% Republicans, 33% independents and 36% Democrats. Forty percent of respondents were 65 or older, and the gender split was evenly divided between men and women. The question over citizenship requirements for elections comes as Secretary Bellows, after admitting on camera that non-citizens are registered to vote, has refused to cooperate with a U.S. Department of Justice investigation into Maine's voter rolls. * You 're receiving The Robinson Report for free. Dr. Atlas investigates the role of government and the private sector in health care quality and access, global trends in health care innovation, and the key economic and civil liberty issues related to health policy.
Dr. Atlas is the author of numerous books, including A Plague Upon Our House: My Fight at the Trump White House to Stop COVID from Destroying America (Post Hill Press), In Excellent Health: Setting the Record Straight on America's Health Care System (Hoover Press), and Restoring Quality Health Care: A Six‐Point Plan for Comprehensive Reform at Lower Cost (Hoover Press). He is also the editor of "Magnetic Resonance Imaging of the Brain and Spine" - the leading textbook in the field, translated into several languages, and now in its 5th edition.

# **Trump draws hard line on Iran nuclear deal with 10-15 day deadline backed by military force**
President Donald Trump used his State of the Union address Tuesday **[to reinforce his mid-February ultimatum giving Iran roughly 10-15 days](https://substack.com/redirect/837657d0-56cd-48e4-b7f3-c7cac7b6d9ba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to reach a nuclear agreement, warning "I will never allow the world's number one sponsor of terror to have a nuclear weapon." Trump said Tehran "wants to make a deal" but hasn't met his core condition: saying "we will never have a nuclear weapon."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/837657d0-56cd-48e4-b7f3-c7cac7b6d9ba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

* **Why it matters:** The deadline is backed by the largest assembly of U.S. naval power in the Middle East since the 2003 Iraq invasion, including aircraft carriers USS Gerald R. Ford and USS Abraham Lincoln commanding 14 major warships with nine Tomahawk-armed destroyers, plus 12 F-22 Raptor stealth fighters deployed to Israel. Trump reminded Congress of Operation Midnight Hammer in 2025, which used B-2 bombers with 30,000-pound "bunker busters" to "obliterate Iran's nuclear weapons program," warning Iran is now "starting it all over again."
* **What 's next:** U.S. negotiators will meet Iranian envoys again in Geneva Thursday, with administration officials demanding Iran halt all uranium enrichment and provide verifiable guarantees its program cannot be reconstituted--terms Iran has repeatedly rejected. Trump warned that without a meaningful agreement, "bad things will happen," while Iran has vowed a "forceful response" to any strikes, saying U.S. troops in the Middle East could be targets. Trump also claimed Iranian authorities killed 32,000 protesters in recent demonstrations, far above independent estimates.

# **Hillary and Bill Clinton to testify under oath in congressional Epstein investigation**
Former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton **[will testify Thursday before the House Oversight Committee](https://substack.com/redirect/fd25c252-50aa-4623-8c3b-c1d4c893c9df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in a closed-door deposition as part of a congressional investigation into Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell, with former President Bill Clinton scheduled to testify Friday. Bill Clinton's testimony will mark the first time a former U.S. president has been forced to testify before Congress, and the first presidential testimony to a congressional panel since Gerald Ford in 1983.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fd25c252-50aa-4623-8c3b-c1d4c893c9df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Why it matters:** The Clintons, both 79, agreed to testify after their offers of sworn statements were rebuffed by Oversight Chairman Rep. James Comer (R-KY), who threatened criminal contempt of Congress charges. Hillary Clinton said in a BBC interview that her husband had flown with Epstein for charitable trips and that she did not recall meeting Epstein but had interacted with Ghislaine Maxwell at Clinton Foundation conferences, adding "we are more than happy to say what we know, which is very limited and totally unrelated to their behavior or their crimes."
* **What 's next:** The two-day closed-door depositions will take place in the Clintons' hometown of Chappaqua, New York, with Democratic and Republican committee members expected to address reporters after Hillary Clinton's deposition scheduled for 11:00 a.m. EST Thursday.

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-jack?refcode=022626_1 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-jack?refcode=022626_1]
Lately, I've been doing some reflecting on my grandfather, President John F. Kennedy, and his legacy of hope.
In my run to fight for NY-12 in Congress, and just as a person, that's what I want to focus on. Hope.
My name is Jack, or John Bouvier Kennedy Schlossberg if you want to know the whole thing.
In high school, I spent hours watching my grandfather's speeches. He taught us all that politics isn't about serving yourself — it's about serving others. When we fight for hope, we're not just doing it for ourselves, we're doing it for each other and the future we all have to share.
I know I have big shoes to fill. In my grandfather's memory, I've led a life of caring about this a lot. I put that care and effort and hope into everything I do.
But this is bigger than me. It's bigger than my family's legacy.
Hope is hard to find in Politics these days, but if we let it die out completely, that's how we really lose. Now cannot be the time to stop caring or turn away. We have to double down in our pursuit of hope.
I really think this election is the one — our last chance to stop Trump and change the direction we're heading in.
I need you to know that I believe we can do it. I believe in hope, and I believe in us. Will you believe with me? You can make a difference by splitting a donation between our campaign for NY-12 and Outrage then Action PAC today >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-jack?refcode=022626_1]

# [🐾 WOOF! A special message from Bailey, a Haley Stevens' campaign dog](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=188925525&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTg4OTI1NTI1LCJpYXQiOjE3NzIxMjE5NjMsImV4cCI6MTc3NDcxMzk2MywiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.mtgfuduiCnxF4WcKQkntUg7xMUl0kzL20EGqj_aRlUY)

Hi, human person! 🐶
_WOOF!!_ It's me! **Bailey, the campaign dog**!
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f5166d11-f06b-49b9-bdd6-9fa23579b69e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Great to meet you! A bit about me: I'm a very good girl, big fan of trees (especially in the UP 🌲), a semi-professional napper, and the unofficial mascot of Team Haley.
My mom, Katelyn, is Haley Stevens' finance director, which means she spends a lot of time looking at screens and saying things like "Q1 projections." Blah blah blah - I JUST WANT PETS! 🐾 Sometimes, I gently remind her that belly rubs are just as important as fundraising goals. Self-care, mom!
Anyway - I've got my paw on the pulse of this campaign! And I'm here to share my dog-perspective of Haley Stevens for Michigan!
Coming to you LIVE, two feet from the ground and on all fours! 🦮 This is:
#### **A Campaign Dog 's-Eye View of Democracy**
You might think I spend all day chewing squeaky toys and chasing squirrels (yes, I do that too, and I have no regrets), but I also get to see what's happening out here on the campaign trail. I've been in the background on Zoom calls, sniffed at least 900 voters, and been in all the meetings (I'm excellent at going from person to person looking for pets). Here's what I've picked up:
🐾 **Michigan is one of the biggest Senate races in the country.
** Everyone's barking about it. This race is going to be close, and it's going to be tough - but us underdogs? We don't back down.
🐾 **Haley has the best shot of any Democrat to win.
** That's not just me saying it (but I am biased because she always scratches my ears _juuuuust_ right). The polls say it too! Voters across Michigan know Haley is the best - she's from here, she's worked her tail off for working families, and she knows all the best spots for Detroit-style pizza! (BUDDYS! Yum.)
🐾 **Haley is loyal, scrappy, and loves Michiganders
** Just like me! But while my passion is stealing a sniff of my mom's Coney dog when she's looking at her phone, Haley is all about protecting Michigan jobs - she even helped lead the auto rescue way back in 2009. I've seen her prepping for speeches while eating lunch in the car, meeting with tons of voters at events all day, walking picket lines with unions, and still remembering to give me a treat when she gets back to HQ. That's dedication. And great snack awareness. (Honestly, an underrated quality in a senator, IMO.)
I love being a Haley Stevens campaign dog. I get to be part of something hopeful and exciting, and I can see that humans are excited about Haley, too! I know this is going to be a tough race, but it is my official opinion that Haley Stevens would be an awesome senator.
So that's the paw-litical rundown!
There will be another update soon, but until then, I'll be doing my part - giving love to staffers and volunteers and reminding Haley about snacks and sitting patiently during long calls. 🐾
Thanks for following along! And if you see me out on the trail, come say hi! I love meeting Michiganders (especially the ones who smell like Coney dogs...)
XOXO,
Bailey 🐶
(_on behalf of my mom Katelyn, Haley, and the whole Team Haley pack)_

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/3d7481db-a92b-40b0-b713-967f11719ca4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

NYT: Trump Leans on Congress to Address His False Claims of Voter Fraud [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=022626_1&amount=25]
President Trump used his State of the Union address to press Congress to advance stalled legislation that purports to address his often-repeated -- and equally often debunked -- claims of widespread election fraud.
The SAVE Act was fast-tracked by opponents of voting rights and passed the U.S. House of Representatives. Now Trump and his MAGA minions are meeting with U.S. Senators, scheming for ways to get this bill through the Senate ahead of November's midterms.
This bill is a stunning assault on our fundamental right to vote, and we can not afford to let this anti-democratic legislation become law, folks.
PITCH IN $35 RIGHT NOW TO STOP THE SAVE ACT NOW ➜ [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=022626_1&amount=35]
Don’t be fooled by the name. This bill would force every voter to present specific types of proof of citizenship to register -- something millions of eligible Americans don’t have on hand. And that’s the point. The bill would also obliterate popular methods of voter registration for all voters, including:
* Registration by mail

* 3rd party voter registration drives

* Online voter registration in states that allow it

* Automatic voter registration
Some estimates say that this bill could disenfranchise up to 11 million eligible Americans , especially women and those who live in under-resourced communities.
“ There’s never been an attack on voting rights out of Congress like this ,” said Alexander Keyssar, a professor of History and Social Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School, and a leading historian of voting rights. “ It’s always been the federal government trying to keep states in check on voting rights, for the most part. ”

How do we know non-citizen voting is a made up problem? Because red states and conservative-leaning institutions have spent millions in taxpayer money and donor dollars searching for it and finding minimal results.
For example: The pro-Trump Heritage Foundation -- an organization that has funded anti-voting initiatives for decades -- maintains a database of "election crimes." Their own records only list 24 instances of non-citizens voting in U.S. elections from 2003 to 2023 . In other words -- 20 years of elections, millions of votes, and only 24 alleged non-citizen voters.
Reuters has a fuller accounting in recent reporting. Florida, for example, spent millions investigating voter fraud and creating a new state department to oversee election security. They've only prosecuted two non-citizens for voting since 2022. North Carolina said they found nine non-citizens registered to vote out of 7.7 million voters. Utah recently investigated their entire voter roll of 2.1 million registered voters and found one registered non-citizen who never attempted to vote.
The conservative CATO Institute says it best: " These investigations affirm what is simply common sense. People largely aren’t willing to risk their status in the United States — the land of economic opportunity — for the ability to cast one more vote out of hundreds of thousands or millions in a state and hundreds of millions in the country. Right now, EMILYs List-backed women are running in some of the most competitive districts in the country. These candidates aren't waiting to see how the maps shake out. They are on the ground, building smart teams, and running the kinds of campaigns that win, even in tough terrain. And we're right there with them — because these are the candidates who will protect the right to choose and block a national abortion ban.

**Our response to anti-democratic GOP gerrymandering? If they're going to steal our seats, we're going to fight hard for theirs.**

That's why we've aggressively broadened our battlefield into red-leaning districts where MAGA extremism has cracked the door open for us — places where Democrats haven't traditionally competed, like CO-04, FL-21, IA-02, KY-06, and SC-01. A few cycles ago, putting resources into these districts would have raised eyebrows. Today, it's smart strategy.

And here's why I know that: in 2025, we saw voters break from the Republican Party. **The data tells a consistent story: when compelling Democratic women are on the ballot, even the unlikeliest voters show up** , especially as Republicans continue to double down on pushing abortion bans that the majority of voters oppose.

The GOP is betting that gerrymandering will be enough for them to eke out the House majority. We're going to prove them wrong, but we need to invest now, before the maps are finalized.

clean_body: These are the districts that can protect the right to choose. | = Peter — With GOP lawmakers fighting to redraw congressional districts in key states, our best projections show that Democrats will need to flip anywhere from three to six seats to take back the U.S. House this year, though the actual number is still uncertain due to pending court challenges. I'm not sharing this to scare you. I'm sharing it because, whether that final number ends up at three, or six, or ten seats — I genuinely believe we can hit it. And the stakes couldn’t be clearer: control of the House will determine whether Republicans keep pushing abortion bans and attacks on reproductive health care — or whether we stop them. ******=**** | = Right now, EMILYs List-backed women are running in some of the most competitive districts in the country. These candidates aren't waiting to see how the maps shake out. They are on the ground, building smart teams, and running the kinds of campaigns that win, even in tough terrain. And we're right there with them — because these are the candidates who will protect the right to choose and block a national abortion ban. Our response to anti-democratic GOP gerrymandering? If they're going to steal our seats, we're going to fight hard for theirs. That's why we've aggressively broadened our battlefield into red-leaning districts where MAGA extremism has cracked the door open for us — places where Democrats haven't traditionally competed, like CO-04, FL-21, IA-02, KY-06, and SC-01. A few cycles ago, putting resources into these districts would have raised eyebrows. Today, it's smart strategy. And here's why I know that: in 2025, we saw voters break from the Republican Party. The data tells a consistent story: when compelling Democratic women are on the ballot, even the unlikeliest voters show up , especially as Republicans continue to double down on pushing abortion bans that the majority of voters oppose. The GOP is betting that gerrymandering will be enough for them to eke out the House majority. We're going to prove them wrong, but we need to invest now, before the maps are finalized. Early money is the difference between a candidate who can build real campaign infrastructure and one who spends the whole race playing catch-up against a well-funded opponent. It's the difference between flipping three, or six, or ten seats — and falling short. ****=****** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue, your donation will go through immediately: = | = ---|--- = | = = | = Thank you for being part of the team, Ben Ray (he/him/his) Deputy Chief Campaigns Officer, Federal and Gubernatorial, EMILYs List | = | | | | | ---|---|---|---|--- Thank you for being a supporter of EMILYs List. name: Michael Bennet
subject: Four freedoms we all deserve
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
Here’s how we can achieve these freedoms right here in Colorado:
#

Friend, it’s Mark Kelly. My friend Michael Bennet is running for Governor in Colorado and needs our help. I hope you’ll read the message below from him, and [**rush a split donation between Michael's campaign and mine.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-bennet.k-diEe&refcode=em260226-1-90&t=1&akid=6377%2E6688874%2Etswl8s)
---
**The freedom to rise, the freedom to learn, the freedom from violence, and the freedom to govern ourselves.**
Hi Friend, I believe that every American is entitled to those four fundamental freedoms. Those values are what have guided my work in public service.
Here’s how we can achieve these freedoms right here in Colorado:
By ensuring Colorado families can afford healthcare, childcare, and housing; by fighting childhood poverty; and by building an economy that works for everyone, not just those at the top, **we can achieve the freedom to rise.**
By modernizing our education system to set our kids up for success, no matter what zip code they are born into, and paying our educators what they deserve, **we can achieve the freedom to learn.**
By partnering with local law enforcement and communities to keep Coloradans safe, fighting the opioid epidemic, and combating the extremism that flourishes on social media, **we can achieve freedom from violence.**
By protecting Coloradans' voting rights, keeping the government out of our bedrooms and doctors' offices, and reforming our electoral system so the people, not dark money, have the most power, **we can achieve the freedom to govern ourselves.**
Achieving these goals in the political climate we are living through right now may feel impossible, but I know fighting for what is fundamental will always be worth it.
_That’s why I’m running for Governor. Working together, right here at home, we can truly achieve these fundamental freedoms and provide the rest of the country with the hopeful and optimistic vision we desperately need._
[**Friend, I can’t and wouldn’t want to do this without you by our side. Will you chip in $3, split between Mark Kelly and myself, to fuel this campaign and help us build a better future for us all?**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-bennet.k-diEe&refcode=em260226-1-90&t=2&akid=6377%2E6688874%2Etswl8s)
Thank you,
Michael

Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a very important way we communicate with supporters like you, but if you want to, you can [ unsubscribe here](https://act.markkelly.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe?t=3&akid=6377%2E6688874%2Etswl8s).
Mark Kelly was a Captain in the U.S. Navy and astronaut. clean_body: Ben will always be my “why." = Ben is my 37-year-old son who was born with cerebral palsy. I got my start in public service as an advocate, helping to ensure that children like Ben would be fully included in their communities and have the same opportunities that all parents want for their children. Now, with extremists like Donald Trump and Robert F. Kennedy Jr. attacking key rights and protections for the disability community, that mission has become more important than ever. That’s why I’ve taken on RFK Jr. for his radical conspiracy theories, his anti-vaccine platform, and his blatant attacks on Americans who live with disabilities. And I’ve stood up to Trump’s efforts to slash Medicaid and government services that the disability community relies on. Today, more than 70 million Americans report that they are living with a disability. It’s clear: We need leaders in the U.S. House and Senate who will fiercely advocate for disabled folks to have the access to the health care, caretakers, jobs, and lives that they deserve. = If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | = | | = | | = | | = | | = I’ll always be fighting for folks like Ben to have a chance to succeed. If I am going to send Lauren Boebert packing and flip this seat blue, I need grassroots donors like you to chip in right now to my campaign: = Please use the links in this email to start a monthly donation through ActBlue: | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = Our republic is being tested in ways that it has never been before. # **The 2026 "Trump Effect"
on IRAs over $50,000**
---
**President Trump’s “One Big Beautiful Bill” is exactly what this country needs.** It’s big, it’s bold, and it’s finally putting American families first. But we have to be honest with you about something that’s hard to say. **Trump’s new plan is moving fast** ... maybe too fast for the old, fragile banking system to handle. Think of it like a powerful cleaning crew coming into a dusty old house. They are going to scrub everything clean, which is wonderful. But if you have fragile family heirlooms sitting out on shaky tables... they might get knocked over in the excitement. It’s not Trump’s fault. He is doing his job. **But the Wall Street banks holding your retirement savings are like those shaky tables.** They are old, tired, and not built for this kind of _**Economic Revolution**._ If you leave your money sitting there, it could get caught in the shake-up.
---
**This is why we hesitate to share this next part publicly.**
---
There is a way to move your **_financial heirloom_** to a safe room before the cleaning starts. It involves a specific, IRS-approved loophole that very few families know about. **To be honest, this loophole works so well it may feel a little unfair**. It allows you to quietly step out of the chaotic banking system to figuratively _**lock** _your savings into something that doesn't care about stock markets or bank failures. It can create a level of peace and quiet that most retirees never get to feel. While your neighbors are glued to the TV worrying about the next market swing, you can turn the TV off, knowing your grandkid's inheritance is sitting in a sanctuary that Wall Street can't touch.
---
# **[We’ve written down exactly how to use this loophole inside our 2026 Patriot’s Wealth Defense Guide.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D)**

name: Jon Ossoff
subject: Why I ran for Senate — and why this moment is just as urgent
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
This is not a drill and it’s not a bad dream
#

[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-ossoff-q12026.ftztxu&refcode=em260226-1-b&t=1&akid=11280%2E3935704%2ESQX8sX)
---
It’s Jon Ossoff. _Let me lay this out, clear as day:_
I am the only Democratic Senator up for reelection in a state Trump won in 2024.
This Senate race in Georgia will be the most competitive and most expensive in the nation.
If you’re outraged by what’s happening to our country — and you’re ready to fight –– [**please split $10 between my reelection campaign and GIFFORDS today.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-ossoff-q12026.ftztxu&refcode=em260226-1-b&t=2&akid=11280%2E3935704%2ESQX8sX)
**[SPLIT A DONATION](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-ossoff-q12026.ftztxu&refcode=em260226-1-b&t=3&akid=11280%2E3935704%2ESQX8sX)**
Otherwise, let me remind you why I ran for Senate — and why this moment is just as urgent.
Before I was elected, I led investigations of corruption and human rights abuses worldwide. We exposed wrongdoing in countries where criticizing the government is dangerous, where whistleblowers and witnesses will only meet in secret, where protest carries the risk of prosecution.
More and more, the atmosphere under Trump reminded me of those places where dissent was silenced by intimidation.
Trump’s rise wasn’t just a crisis. It was a warning.
I ran for Senate because I saw the danger in electing someone so profoundly unfit for the presidency and I wanted to confront the corruption that made his rise possible.
I also ran — years before the Dobbs decision — because it was already clear the GOP was coming for reproductive rights. I saw Georgia as the front line in that fight. With a six-week ban now in place here, and Republicans pushing for a national abortion ban, it still is.
**Now this President is staging a power grab unprecedented in our history:**
* He’s freed violent criminals who attacked the Capitol on his behalf.
* Purged independent watchdogs across government.
* Stacked key agencies with loyalists — and called on them to investigate his political opponents.
* Defied and threatened federal judges.
* Undermined the press.

Trump’s goal isn’t just revenge. He wants to use the government to crush the opposition. And now, Americans are living in fear of their own government.
This is not a drill and it’s not a bad dream. As citizens, it is the test of our lifetimes.
**In 2020, the pundits said flipping a Republican Senate seat in Georgia couldn’t be done. But we built one of the strongest voter mobilization programs in Senate campaign history — and we won. That victory won the Senate majority.**
Now we must win again. And we _will_ win again.
Just like last time, I can’t do it alone.
So I’m asking:
[**Please split a contribution between my reelection campaign and GIFFORDS today, of $10 or any amount that works for you.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-ossoff-q12026.ftztxu&refcode=em260226-1-b&t=4&akid=11280%2E3935704%2ESQX8sX)
The average online donation to our campaign is around $30. Many give less. Some give more.
All that matters is that lots and lots of people are contributing what they can to power our grassroots campaign. Please, contribute today.

| | On Tuesday, President Trump delivered his State of the Union address. He predictably touted that everything was great regarding affordability and our economy, but we know prices are too high. **Prices are soaring and hurting family budgets across the region.** We see through Trump's rhetoric. We know grocery and gas prices are up, yet President Trump promised these would go down. We know that health care prices are up, and Republicans in Congress had the opportunity to lower those prices by passing the Affordable Care Act tax credits, making health care premiums lower. Trump thinks affordability is a "hoax" when we know the truth of his reckless tariffs. President Trump will never own up to the fact that his tariff war has directly raised costs for families all across the country. In Northwest Washington, we are feeling the impact of his tariff war because of our close economic ties with our neighbors in British Columbia, Canada. He does not believe affordability is important to Americans, but I believe we should be working day and night to lower grocery prices, gas prices, and health care prices. I am ready to get to work for the families of Northwest Washington. Affordability must be at the top of our agenda and not dismissed as a "hoax". clean_body: Prices are soaring and hurting family budgets across the region. | | | | On Tuesday, President Trump delivered his State of the Union address. He predictably touted that everything was great regarding affordability and our economy, but we know prices are too high. Prices are soaring and hurting family budgets across the region. We see through Trump's rhetoric. We know grocery and gas prices are up, yet President Trump promised these would go down. We know that health care prices are up, and Republicans in Congress had the opportunity to lower those prices by passing the Affordable Care Act tax credits, making health care premiums lower. Trump thinks affordability is a "hoax" when we know the truth of his reckless tariffs. President Trump will never own up to the fact that his tariff war has directly raised costs for families all across the country. In Northwest Washington, we are feeling the impact of his tariff war because of our close economic ties with our neighbors in British Columbia, Canada. He does not believe affordability is important to Americans, but I believe we should be working day and night to lower grocery prices, gas prices, and health care prices. I am ready to get to work for the families of Northwest Washington. Affordability must be at the top of our agenda and not dismissed as a "hoax". We’re living in a time of unprecedented corruption. Under a Republican-controlled House, Senate, presidency, and Supreme Court, federal officers are kidnapping and torturing our neighbors, we’re facing the worst measles and flu outbreaks in thirty years, and Trump's FBI is using taxpayer dollars to cover up his ties to Jeffrey Epstein.
As a mom of two, a lung and critical care doctor, and a fed-up American, I will not stand by while Trump and his GOP enablers erode our rights and stick us with the bill to pay for their malfeasance.
That’s why I’ve visited multiple detention centers, DEMANDING Trump release Oregonians. I also introduced legislation to impeach Kristi Noem and make it illegal for ICE agents to hide their faces. And I passed my first bill in the House to protect veterans and help them reintegrate into civilian life. But I’m not done yet...
* I am determined to make accessible, affordable healthcare available to every Oregonian.
* I will continue to fight to defund and dismantle ICE and demand freedom and justice for our kidnapped neighbors.
* I will do all I can to help make government worthy of your trust—which means we root out corruption and actually make life better for working families across this country.
I took an oath as a physician to do no harm, to protect and advocate for patients. I am building a movement to elect physicians, scientists, and experts to Congress, who will use REAL facts, science, and truth to combat MAGA and their MAHA agenda.

**Friend,**
My dad arrived in Huntington Beach with $20 in his pocket.
That's not a figure of speech. Twenty dollars. That was everything we had after three days in the South China Sea and thirty months in refugee camps. He held onto that $20 like it was a promise — proof that if you work hard enough, if you sacrifice enough, if you follow the rules, America will meet you halfway.
He believed that. We all did.
This week, Governor Newsom announced he's spending **$35 million** in taxpayer money — right in the middle of a $2.9 billion state budget deficit — on legal defense for people who didn't come through the process at all.
# THIRTY-FIVE MILLION DOLLARS.
I want to be clear about something, because I know how this gets twisted: **I am not anti-immigrant.** I am an immigrant. My family paid the price of doing it legally — and it nearly killed us.
We spent thirty months in refugee camps doing it the right way. We didn't take shortcuts. We didn't have anyone funding our legal defense. We had each other, a lot of faith, and eventually — $20.
What Newsom just did isn't compassion. It's a slap in the face to every family that sacrificed the way mine did. And he's doing it with your money, while California can't balance its own books.
## California's message to legal immigrants:
You were fools to follow the rules.
I refuse to accept that. And I think you do too.
Derek Tran sits in Washington and doesn't push back on any of this. He votes with Newsom's party, protects their agenda, and goes home. Meanwhile, the community that built this district — Vietnamese families, Korean families, Filipino families who came here the right way — gets nothing but a higher tax bill.
I'm running because someone who actually lived this story needs to be in that seat. Not a career politician. Someone who knows what $20 in your father's pocket actually means.
### Here's what $20 means to me — and what it can do for us:
My dad's $20 stretched further than anyone thought possible. He made it work. That's the immigrant spirit — not handouts, not workarounds. **Hard work. The right way.**
If you can chip in $20 today, you're carrying that same spirit forward — and putting someone in Congress who actually lived it.

Hi Peter,

Courtesy of Greg Abbott, Ken Paxton, and their majority-male state legislature, Texas has a near-total abortion ban, with some of the strictest laws in the nation.

They have made it dangerous to be a woman in Texas. As Leticia Gutierrez, running for U.S. Congress in Texas, told us, “There are many reports of women dying due to doctors refusing to operate an abortion despite the mother's health being at risk, because the doctors fear criminal charges. Legislation is frequently proposed to criminalize people who assist anyone seeking an abortion in or out of the state.”

While there is a loud national conversation about abortion rights at the federal level, women in states like Texas are being left behind. But here’s the thing:

**Texas has an important primary election coming up in a matter of days – on March 3rd.**

Earlier this week, President Trump delivered a record-setting State of the Union address--one hour and forty-eight minutes of showmanship, policy declarations, and a parade of his greatest successes. Medal of Honor presentations, the gold medal-winning men's hockey team receiving a bipartisan standing ovation, and the ejection of a protesting congressman all made for compelling television. But if you zoom out--and I always encourage zooming out--what the speech revealed about the state of the American economy, global trade dynamics, and the investment landscape was far more interesting than the theatrics.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/677da640-446d-48d9-b707-0d9a30634a3c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
There are lots of great recaps of the speech, but let me connect some dots to share my interpretation of what was interesting and caught my attention. The most consequential backdrop to this speech was not political but legal. Just four days before his address, the Supreme Court struck down the president's sweeping IEEPA tariffs in a 6-3 decision, ruling that he had exceeded his authority and that his tariffs are illegal. This was the centerpiece of Trump's economic agenda--gone, just like that. And yet, rather than acknowledge the setback, the president told Congress that "congressional action will not be necessary" to reimpose tariffs. He has already signed a new 10 percent global tariff under Section 122 of the Trade Act of 1974, with plans to raise it to 15 percent. The message was unmistakable: the trade war will continue, albeit under a different legal framework.
Recent commentary has missed a key distinction. The Supreme Court ruling didn't end tariff uncertainty--it transformed it. Businesses that had spent the last year navigating one set of rules are now confronting an entirely new legal basis for trade restrictions, one that comes with a 150-day expiration clock and may face its own legal challenges. For a CEO trying to plan capital expenditures or the manufacturer deciding where to source components, this is not relief. It is a different flavor of chaos, continued uncertainty, and a paralyzing sense that the rules of the road are not "set." And as someone who runs a frozen pizza manufacturing company and has closely monitored potential impacts on my supply chain, I can tell you: **uncertainty is the real tax on business, not the tariff**.
* * *
## [The Short (and Long) of Trump's Trade War](https://substack.com/redirect/47b03527-f345-4a70-ae62-f99b4e099abc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

[As the global trade war continues unabated, each new day brings headlines sounding the alarm over its impact. Deciphering how various policies could impact specific industries is no trivial task and requires thinking about developments through multiples perspectives across various geographies and timelines.](https://substack.com/redirect/47b03527-f345-4a70-ae62-f99b4e099abc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

* * *
The president claimed that tariffs will eventually replace the income tax, relieving the financial burden on ordinary Americans. This is a fascinating idea with deep historical roots--the United States did, in fact, fund itself primarily through tariffs before the 16th Amendment. And I'm all for a lower tax burden on the American consumer, but even if we did manage to pay for the US budget via tariffs alone, there would be an indirect tax effectively paid by the consumers via higher price goods. Of course, incomes would be higher, too.
But let's think critically about this rather than outsourcing our analysis to partisan pundits. Federal revenue needs are approximately $5 trillion annually. Tariff revenue, even at elevated levels, has been well short of that number. ...

But if you zoom out--and I always encourage zooming out--what the speech revealed about the state of the American economy, global trade dynamics, and the investment landscape was far more interesting than the theatrics. There are lots of great recaps of the speech, but let me connect some dots to share my interpretation of what was interesting and caught my attention. The most consequential backdrop to this speech was not political but legal. Just four days before his address, the Supreme Court struck down the president's sweeping IEEPA tariffs in a 6-3 decision, ruling that he had exceeded his authority and that his tariffs are illegal. This was the centerpiece of Trump's economic agenda--gone, just like that. And yet, rather than acknowledge the setback, the president told Congress that "congressional action will not be necessary" to reimpose tariffs. He has already signed a new 10 percent global tariff under Section 122 of the Trade Act of 1974, with plans to raise it to 15 percent. The message was unmistakable: the trade war will continue, albeit under a different legal framework. Recent commentary has missed a key distinction. The Supreme Court ruling didn't end tariff uncertainty--it transformed it. Businesses that had spent the last year navigating one set of rules are now confronting an entirely new legal basis for trade restrictions, one that comes with a 150-day expiration clock and may face its own legal challenges. For a CEO trying to plan capital expenditures or the manufacturer deciding where to source components, this is not relief. It is a different flavor of chaos, continued uncertainty, and a paralyzing sense that the rules of the road are not "set." And as someone who runs a frozen pizza manufacturing company and has closely monitored potential impacts on my supply chain, I can tell you: uncertainty is the real tax on business, not the tariff. | | | | ---|---|--- | May 12, 2025 | * The president claimed that tariffs will eventually replace the income tax, relieving the financial burden on ordinary Americans. This is a fascinating idea with deep historical roots--the United States did, in fact, fund itself primarily through tariffs before the 16th Amendment. And I'm all for a lower tax burden on the American consumer, but even if we did manage to pay for the US budget via tariffs alone, there would be an indirect tax effectively paid by the consumers via higher price goods. Of course, incomes would be higher, too. But let's think critically about this rather than outsourcing our analysis to partisan pundits. Federal revenue needs are approximately $5 trillion annually. Tariff revenue, even at elevated levels, has been well short of that number. ... body:
# [](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/629?refcode=em20260226-241&t=1&akid=241%2E12592%2ELJpV7Q)
Is there anything we can say to earn your support today?
What if we told you **our election is in April,** _not_ November?
What if we told you that **winning back the U.S. House majority could hinge on what happens here** in Virginia?
What if we reminded you that **members of Donald Trump’s close political circle are working to defeat this amendment** — because they know fair maps threaten their power?
**And what if we told you that even $5 makes a difference?**
It’s true! When you pitch in $5, someone else does too, and someone else after that. That’s how grassroots movements are built — one small donation at a time.
[**So with all of that in mind, will you chip in $5 or whatever you can today to help us pass the redistricting amendment in April?**](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/1179?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260226_1.ZRLmRr&refcode=20260226-241&t=2&akid=241%2E12592%2ELJpV7Q)

Thank you,
Virginians for Fair Elections

name: Eileen for Colorado
subject: Ret. Rear Admiral Eileen Earns Endorsement from Democrat Who Came Within 550 Votes of Defeating Lauren Boebert
body:
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE****Date:** February 26, 2026 **Contact:**[ Taylor Gillespie](mailto:taylorg@eileenforcolorado.com), 720-557-6185
---
| | **Ret. Rear Admiral Eileen Earns Endorsement from Democrat Who Came Within 550 Votes of Defeating Lauren Boebert** _Western Slope businessman Adam Frisch— who mounted a historic near-upset against Lauren Boebert— endorses Eileen Laubacher._
---
| | **Highlands Ranch, CO** – Today, retired Rear Admiral Eileen Laubacher announced a key endorsement from former Colorado congressional candidate Adam Frisch. In 2022, nearly every political pundit wrote Frisch off. After Lauren Boebert’s six-point victory in 2020, many assumed the district was safely out of reach and that he didn’t stand a chance. Instead, Frisch shocked the nation—coming just 546 votes shy of defeating Boebert in the closest House race in the country. That race didn’t just surprise the political class; it reshaped Colorado politics and ultimately pushed Boebert to abandon her district in search of what she believed would be safer ground. Now, Frisch is backing Eileen Laubacher to finish what he started.
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | **Adam Frisch had this to say,** _“Lauren Boebert is vulnerable. We proved that in 2022. But winning this district takes more than momentum - it takes credibility, discipline and the ability to earn trust across party lines. EIleen Laubacher is the only candidate in this race with the leadership background, record of service, and strength to unite independents, Democrats and Republicans to actually defeat Boebert and give the district real representation in Congress.”_ Eileen brings more than three decades of leadership experience to the race. A retired Rear Admiral, she deployed to Afghanistan while raising five children and spent her career leading sailors, advising senior national security leaders, and defending the Constitution.
---
| |
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | Frisch’s endorsement underscores a clear message: the path to victory is real and Eileen Laubacher is the candidate who can secure it._“I'm honored to be endorsed by Adam Frisch,”_ said **Retired Rear Admiral Eileen Laubacher**. _“Adam shares my vision for lowering costs for Colorado families, supporting our farmers and ranchers, and addressing the issues plaguing our rural healthcare system. His campaign was an inspiration for how to take on extremism and I am ready to finish the job.”_ _Titles, ranks, and military service are used for identification purposes only and do not imply endorsement by the Department of Defense.__**##**_

body:
Arizonans are ready for results, not rhetoric.
| | | | Peter,
With the primary on the horizon and our shared commitment to Arizona’s future stronger than ever, I wanted to share a quick update from the campaign trail. Over the past few weeks, it has been incredibly encouraging to connect with so many residents across north Phoenix, Scottsdale, Fountain Hills, and throughout the district who are united in their desire for secure borders, economic opportunity, and strong Republican leadership in Washington.
My journey from the NFL to this campaign has always been about showing up, putting in the work, and delivering results, and that is exactly what we are doing every day.
---
These past few weeks have reinforced why I am running: to be a strong, tested voice for common-sense values and to deliver the leadership our district deserves. I am honored to have President Trump’s endorsement and proud to be the only candidate in this race with his full support.
Together, we are focused on delivering what voters demanded: secure borders, lower costs for families, protection of our freedoms, and an economy that works for hardworking Arizonans. The contrast with the policies coming from the far left could not be clearer, and Arizonans are ready for results, not rhetoric.

|
---

_**Recent Campaign Highlights**_
I have been all over AZ-01 meeting with voters, community leaders, and supporters, and the energy out there is incredible. Here are a few highlights from the past couple of weeks:
* Honored to be the only candidate in AZ-01 endorsed by President Trump

I am deeply grateful for his support and proud to be running as the candidate committed to delivering the agenda Arizonans voted for.

name: Justin Streiff, Turning Point USA
subject: The Left wants our students silenced
body:
It’s getting ugly on campus...
One of the most hostile semesters Turning Point USA students have ever faced.
| | | [](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=bfe25016ccd34d2c9805cbf70f62b996&_e=hnmw5aq5Tnwh2Uzk20ivQxNgnUui0uvOjswGQIEiEPphUF1jRPu0sA4BbvCD8ki-CrMOW_LxboqC_bfVlLKe7Gbi3BOvMu4ubGnq4iGDRd88Lvm57TXJHoHLELWT4WAc5bDbgz3bUsjWVP6Apd--ksBJaear2IImD6GrMJRob4QLIhDk7GJRf407W2bnwbPPiSeLjrXcQzTCvpIbjeBe7QIJabNJxQhXH2sjiklY9C5ABZEFAyqAiLrkvf79Sq8u-PbH6gDFQo2bTr8inKUoKM-X9NyfSXL7FydxadHNHFcCyjY0aKo1k5gMamypyVoFZA7OWLWvtFRAVPDEdc5zgBn15O1vGxJkpATGeB-dW28RHzjEz3XmRKnMnc34cpvDWCT5egsv5hnWdsCKk_rueAQE0vmjx90wpoQ_cMSRmX01YUt3gSq3o5CKX1Ki1Oc2ZEC_FuJMNMFQXVkONNMUuBM7Yp8cG40Hz4hSyKsxeaDFXNXblAwsBv3vr7F-2j-kGJFRnX625HMuAjfhEGVLn565K_WPH5Te9vyUq58yADFVD11JXLYC9hrShGnL2uGwvKyOPCLF6rUIfCJkx3CniooNv_uuXhcmbpKhEPHBhrF-ZzYoxFTQ8r9M3J7CS894p8KsNoBOhc5BFUZXOjAAMuFTdaRvZRIfy1msU427bsdUB95zLseItBEFUgqKJMQDuw3YfLwIJx2j3_mIyQQeog%3D%3D)
---
| | Peter,
---
I have to say it...

The campus climate this spring?

_It 's been downright ugly._

To be frank, the Left has never made it easy for our students. That's always come with the territory when you're speaking truth deep in the belly of the beast...

But this semester is different.

**This has been one of the most hostile semesters Turning Point USA students have ever faced. **

From coast to coast, high school and college students who dared to stand for faith, freedom, and this great nation have been stalked, slandered, threatened, and in some cases -- _physically attacked. _

All for saying what you and I know to be true:

That America is worth defending. That speech must remain free. And that Charlie Kirk's life and legacy meant something.

And despite the opposition -- our students didn't back down.

They didn't run. They didn't hide.

They showed up -- earlier, louder, and stronger than ever before.

_But not without cost. _

**Let me tell you more about what our students have been up against so far this year... **

In Maryland, one of our high school leaders -- just 17 years old -- helped organize a Club America event on campus back in December.

It was peaceful. Students only. Parental permission required. No outside adults. Everything done by the book.

And yet, weeks later, during a recent local school board meeting...

A local woman stood up and publicly accused this student of "grooming children."

Then she went even further.

She told the board: _" All members of this Board are mandatory reporters... Based on the circumstances surrounding this event, **a report was made to Child Protective Services. " **_

Yes, you read that right -- she weaponized CPS against one of our students.

Filed against a **minor. **

For organizing a pro-America Turning Point USA event with his friends.

Now, I want you to imagine being 17 years old... doing everything right... following every rule... showing up with courage and conviction...

And then hearing a stranger stand up in front of your entire community and imply that you're a danger to children.

It 's been downright ugly. To be frank, the Left has never made it easy for our students. That's always come with the territory when you're speaking truth deep in the belly of the beast... But this semester is different. This has been one of the most hostile semesters Turning Point USA students have ever faced. From coast to coast, high school and college students who dared to stand for faith, freedom, and this great nation have been stalked, slandered, threatened, and in some cases -- physically attacked. All for saying what you and I know to be true: That America is worth defending. That speech must remain free. And that Charlie Kirk's life and legacy meant something. And despite the opposition -- our students didn't back down. They didn't run. They didn't hide. They showed up -- earlier, louder, and stronger than ever before. But not without cost. Let me tell you more about what our students have been up against so far this year... In Maryland, one of our high school leaders -- just 17 years old -- helped organize a Club America event on campus back in December. It was peaceful. Students only. Parental permission required. No outside adults. Everything done by the book. And yet, weeks later, during a recent local school board meeting... A local woman stood up and publicly accused this student of "grooming children." Then she went even further. She told the board: " All members of this Board are mandatory reporters... Based on the circumstances surrounding this event, a report was made to Child Protective Services. " Yes, you read that right -- she weaponized CPS against one of our students. Filed against a minor. For organizing a pro-America Turning Point USA event with his friends. Now, I want you to imagine being 17 years old... doing everything right... following every rule... showing up with courage and conviction... And then hearing a stranger stand up in front of your entire community and imply that you're a danger to children. That you need to be investigated. That you're the problem. Above: "Nancy" -- the Leftist Karen who filed a CPS report against a local Club America chapter and spoke out against them at a recent school board meeting. How would you respond? Because I'll tell you what he did... He walked up to that microphone -- calm, steady, unshaken -- and said: " We have been accused of many things... I'm the president of the group. I'm 17, I'm a minor. I can't groom children because I am a child." Seventeen years old. Standing alone. But standing strong in front of his entire community while facing outrageous, malicious accusations. That's courage. The kind of courage Charlie would've been proud of. And that courage is catching fire across the country. But so is the hatred. Because what happened in Maryland wasn't an isolated incident... It's just the beginning: 🚨 At Lawrence University in Wisconsin, Leftists on campus are trying to permanently shut down a brand-new TPUSA chapter before it even starts. Never mind that Lawrence has over 160 student clubs... and not one is right-leaning. Or that the university handbook bans discrimination based on political affiliation. One of our students there is now receiving death threats. And instead of protecting him? The Left-wing student government is putting the chapter's fate up to a campus-wide vote. 🚨 At Iowa State University, Colby Brandt -- the student body president -- was threatened with impeachment because he had connections to TPUSA. Fortunately, his "impeachment" was dismissed by the student government's judicial branch... But this was only after the outrage that followed on social media and the university's administration came to its senses. 🚨 At Worcester Polytechnic, one of our signs that featured a quote with Charlie was vandalized with the phrase: "he should've ducked ahole." 🚨 At Lake Zurich High School, one of our students held an "I ❤️ ICE" sign -- and was physically threatened by a peer. On school grounds and caught on camera. 🚨 At the University of Houston, a Leftist mocked Charlie Kirk's assassination while harassing TPUSA students at a tabling event on campus -- wishing cancer and paralysis on their families while making sexual gestures. 🚨 And at Coastal Carolina Community College, a professor was recorded saying this in front of his class: "Did he (Charlie Kirk) deserve to die? No... but..." Then he added: " He was a racist piece of st. And Turning Point USA is a racist piece of st organization." The message was clear. I could go on and on with more examples of the Left's hatred towards our students... But while they mock Charlie's death, encourage hate, harassment, and try to poison students against the very ideas our country was built on... In the face of all this -- our students aren 't folding. Not one bit. They're still tabling at campus events. They're still meeting after school -- still recruiting, still growing. They're still passing out pocket Constitutions and American flags. They're still launching chapters in hostile territory -- places where they've been told, outright, that they're not welcome. And while their peers stage "ICE Walkouts" and chaos in the halls... Our students are gathering to pray -- for their schools, for law enforcement, and for this nation -- quietly around their school's flagpole. That's because these students made a decision -- the same decision Charlie challenged them to every day: " It doesn't take skill to be courageous. It takes a choice." They chose courage. They chose to stand for faith, freedom, and family. They chose to defend everything that makes this country worth fighting for. They truly are the courageous generation. In fact, since Charlie 's assassination last September: 🔥 Over 140,000 students raised their hands to get involved 🔥 4,600+ active chapters are now operating across America 🔥 More than 1 million students are part of this movement And Peter, patriots like you are the reason they've been able to do it... Because while the Left mocked Charlie's death-- while the hate followed and the attacks intensified -- you didn't disappear. Patriots like you stood firm. You stood with these students. You made it clear: The mission doesn 't end here. And now, because of your faithfulness, we 're watching the seeds Charlie planted come to life in high schools, colleges, and communities across this country. Our students may not know your name... But they know someone made it possible for them to take a stand on their campus. They're walking into classrooms bolder than ever. Speaking truth in places where lies once ruled. Because someone gave them the chance. That someone was you. Patriots like you reminded these students that they're not alone -- even when it feels like it. You helped push back the darkness. You made space for courage to grow. The kind of courage Charlie lived for. The kind of courage he gave everything for. So, thank you, Peter. Thank you for giving these young patriots a fighting chance. We will not stop. We will not retreat. We will keep standing for truth -- louder and stronger than ever before. Because Charlie's mission didn't end with his life. It's being carried forward -- by thousands of students... and by you. And that 's the one thing the Left can't stand. Let's keep pushing. Let's keep growing. Let's keep going -- together. | | For Charlie, Justin Streiff Chief Operating Officer Turning Point USA P.S. Peter, thank you again for taking a stand for our brave students. It's truly incredible watching these students from across the country lining up to start the next wave of new Turning Point chapters. They're watching what's happening... seeing the attacks... hearing the hate from the Left... And still saying: " Sign me up." All they need? A little backup. Every new chapter receives a full activism kit from Turning Point USA, filled with everything they need to lead boldly: ✅ Pocket Constitutions ✅ American Flags ✅ Chapter Leadership Tools ✅ Organizing Guides ✅ Patriotic TPUSA Gear Each one costs just $25 to send to a student chapter. You don't need to start a chapter yourself. But you can help a new one get off the ground. And you can be the reason a kid on a hostile campus doesn't feel like they're fighting alone. ** 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

subject: Term Limits: I Don’t Plan on Serving More Than One Term
body:
Fellow Minnesotan to Fellow Minnesotan.

| | | | | [|
---](https://gmail.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3aa86647bf142972a85274d7e&id=85dd3a92c1&e=49d94faf06)
| | | | [|
---](https://gmail.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3aa86647bf142972a85274d7e&id=84302c8f69&e=49d94faf06)
| | **Term Limits: I Don't Plan on Serving More Than One Term (Key Issues)**

---
| |

Friends,
As things stand today, **I don’t plan on serving more than one term.** My intention at this point is to serve faithfully and then to let the voice of the people speak.
That said, I am a firm believer in freedom. If the people decide they want to elect the same person again, I believe that voice should be heard. Restricting the people’s right to choose their representative is not, in my view, aligned with the principles of liberty.
**The real concern many are raising isn’t truly about term limits — it’s about campaign finance.** Outside money and large donors can distort the process, making it harder to ensure that elected officials are accountable to the people rather than special interests. On that issue, I agree: we should be focused on meaningful campaign finance limits **so that the people’s voice — not big-dollar influence — drives elections.**
**Additionally, I believe unelected bureaucrats appointed to lead departments should absolutely have term limits.** The public does not get the opportunity to vote on these individuals, and we should not be locked into long-term appointments without accountability.
I hope this clarifies my position. My views on the issues are outlined on my website, and I’ve attached a shorter version in flyer format for your reference. Since 2015 I have been a supporter of President Donald J. Trump. [**TRUMP has far exceeded my expectations and I enthusiastically support his agenda to Make America Great Again**](https://gmail.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3aa86647bf142972a85274d7e&id=68a3c965f5&e=49d94faf06)**.** If you didn't see his State of the Union Address I would suggest you watch it.
Please let me know if there’s anything further you’d like to discuss. [Email, text or chat with me on my website. ](https://gmail.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3aa86647bf142972a85274d7e&id=6ff0a32b5d&e=49d94faf06)
Best regards,
Alycia R. Gruenhagen **Candidate for U.S. Senate, Minnesota** Glencoe, MN **www.alycia4senate.com** Proudly representing OUR SHARED Minnesota values.

The real concern many are raising isn’t truly about term limits — it’s about campaign finance. Outside money and large donors can distort the process, making it harder to ensure that elected officials are accountable to the people rather than special interests. On that issue, I agree: we should be focused on meaningful campaign finance limits so that the people’s voice — not big-dollar influence — drives elections. Additionally, I believe unelected bureaucrats appointed to lead departments should absolutely have term limits. The public does not get the opportunity to vote on these individuals, and we should not be locked into long-term appointments without accountability. I hope this clarifies my position. My views on the issues are outlined on my website, and I’ve attached a shorter version in flyer format for your reference. Since 2015 I have been a supporter of President Donald J. Trump. . If you didn't see his State of the Union Address I would suggest you watch it. Please let me know if there’s anything further you’d like to discuss. Best regards, Alycia R.
