The Washington Post **[suffered losses exceeding $100 million in 2025,](https://substack.com/redirect/3fab5eaa-79ae-42be-a02c-e62b61ce9454?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** according to a Wall Street Journal report, capping three years of heavy red ink that prompted massive layoffs of about 30% of its newsroom staff earlier this month as owner Jeff Bezos-owned outlet grapples with declining revenue and productivity.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3fab5eaa-79ae-42be-a02c-e62b61ce9454?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Massive Cumulative Losses:** The three-year total nears $240-277 million with prior years around $77-100 million each, far outstripping recent revenue.
* **Sharp Productivity Drop:** News stories published fell 42% since 2020 while newsroom costs rose 16%, blamed on prior over-hiring and overspending.
* **Deep Staff Reductions:** 350-375 journalists cut, representing roughly 45% of the newsroom, following leadership changes and Bezos ending subsidies.
* **Leadership Response:** Acting executives cited years of expenses surpassing revenue from hundreds of pre-2022 hires, signaling push to refocus operations.

I am the third Jewish woman and the first former synagogue president ever elected to the United States Senate. My faith is deeply tied to who I am, what I fight for, and my role as a lawmaker.
It’s part of why I care about the issues that I do, and it means that I bring with me the same struggles that all Jews face. Most prominently, the threat and impact of discrimination is part of my story – as it is for so many Americans.
**My faith and experiences will always guide my fight to make positive change for communities in Nevada and across the country. But right now, I’m coming up $5,617 short ahead of my end-of-month fundraising deadline to power this fight in the Senate.**

When I was just a few years old, I was playing in a swimming pool with my mom when a lifeguard on duty told us we were “dirty” because we were Jewish. We had to leave the pool immediately, and my mom never forgot that interaction.
Nearly every Jewish American has had a moment in their lives when they experience or witness antisemitism like that firsthand, and the problem is especially serious today.
Swastika graffiti. Physical assaults and threats. Firebombings. MULTIPLE deadly mass shootings. These attacks on Jews are not isolated incidents. They represent a regression toward one of civilization’s darkest chapters.
Addressing this kind of violent antisemitism is an issue I’ve been working on since before I came to Congress and throughout my time in the House and Senate. **That is why:**
* I founded the Senate’s first ever Bipartisan Task Force for Combating Antisemitism – which now includes more than half the Senate as members.

* I successfully pushed the Biden administration to create the first-ever National Strategy to Counter Antisemitism, which took a whole-of-government approach to tackling rising hate.

* I introduced bipartisan legislation to address antisemitism on college campuses across the country.

* I led the effort in Congress to increase the power of the State Department’s Special Envoy to Monitor and Combat Antisemitism by raising the position to the rank of Ambassador.

* I introduced and successfully passed into law reauthorization of the Never Again Education Act, which helps educate our communities about the Holocaust.

* I led the charge to stop the Trump administration from weakening Coast Guard standards for hate symbols like swastikas.

* I'm currently calling on Republicans to reject the nomination of Jeremy Carl to the State Department because of his hateful, antisemitic views.

The fight against antisemitism is part of my wider efforts to make our country a place where _nobody_ is targeted because of who they are, as I was as a little girl. That's why I’m also continuing to speak out against Trump’s hateful anti-immigrant crackdown that has _specifically targeted minors_ and left both migrants and American citizens dead.

clean_body: Can I count on your support ahead of my end-of-month fundraising deadline? | | | Friend, I am the third Jewish woman and the first former synagogue president ever elected to the United States Senate. My faith is deeply tied to who I am, what I fight for, and my role as a lawmaker. It’s part of why I care about the issues that I do, and it means that I bring with me the same struggles that all Jews face. Most prominently, the threat and impact of discrimination is part of my story – as it is for so many Americans. My faith and experiences will always guide my fight to make positive change for communities in Nevada and across the country. But right now, I’m coming up $5,617 short ahead of my end-of-month fundraising deadline to power this fight in the Senate. = | | = When I was just a few years old, I was playing in a swimming pool with my mom when a lifeguard on duty told us we were “dirty” because we were Jewish. We had to leave the pool immediately, and my mom never forgot that interaction. Nearly every Jewish American has had a moment in their lives when they experience or witness antisemitism like that firsthand, and the problem is especially serious today. Swastika graffiti. Physical assaults and threats. Firebombings. MULTIPLE deadly mass shootings. These attacks on Jews are not isolated incidents. They represent a regression toward one of civilization’s darkest chapters. Addressing this kind of violent antisemitism is an issue I’ve been working on since before I came to Congress and throughout my time in the House and Senate. That is why: I founded the Senate’s first ever Bipartisan Task Force for Combating Antisemitism – which now includes more than half the Senate as members. I successfully pushed the Biden administration to create the first-ever National Strategy to Counter Antisemitism, which took a whole-of-government approach to tackling rising hate. I introduced bipartisan legislation to address antisemitism on college campuses across the country. I led the effort in Congress to increase the power of the State Department’s Special Envoy to Monitor and Combat Antisemitism by raising the position to the rank of Ambassador. I introduced and successfully passed into law reauthorization of the Never Again Education Act, which helps educate our communities about the Holocaust. I led the charge to stop the Trump administration from weakening Coast Guard standards for hate symbols like swastikas. I'm currently calling on Republicans to reject the nomination of Jeremy Carl to the State Department because of his hateful, antisemitic views. The fight against antisemitism is part of my wider efforts to make our country a place where nobody is targeted because of who they are, as I was as a little girl. That's why I’m also continuing to speak out against Trump’s hateful anti-immigrant crackdown that has specifically targeted minors and left both migrants and American citizens dead. Your support is crucial**to powering this work – and I’m urgently counting on that support right now ahead of my critical end-of-month fundraising deadline. = If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | = | | = | | = | | = Thank you, friend. Jacky | | = A note from Sen. Jacky Rosen: Friend, I’m fighting tirelessly in the Senate to deliver progress for people across Nevada and our country. But with Donald Trump in the White House and Republicans in control of both houses of Congress, I need your grassroots support to keep up the fights that matter most. Senate Democrats like me are the only thing standing in the way of Trump's extreme agenda that will hurt everyday Americans. That's why I need people like you on my side to help defend our progress and take back power from the GOP. = You can also =** to become a core member of our team and receive exclusive updates from my campaign. I have to say it...

The campus climate this spring?

_It 's been downright ugly._

To be frank, the Left has never made it easy for our students. That's always come with the territory when you're speaking truth deep in the belly of the beast...

But this semester is different.

**This has been one of the most hostile semesters Turning Point USA students have ever faced. **

From coast to coast, high school and college students who dared to stand for faith, freedom, and this great nation have been stalked, slandered, threatened, and in some cases -- _physically attacked. _

All for saying what you and I know to be true:

That America is worth defending. That speech must remain free. And that Charlie Kirk's life and legacy meant something.

And despite the opposition -- our students didn't back down.

They didn't run. They didn't hide.

They showed up -- earlier, louder, and stronger than ever before.

_But not without cost. _

**Let me tell you more about what our students have been up against so far this year... **

In Maryland, one of our high school leaders -- just 17 years old -- helped organize a Club America event on campus back in December.

It was peaceful. Students only. Parental permission required. No outside adults. Everything done by the book.

And yet, weeks later, during a recent local school board meeting...

A local woman stood up and publicly accused this student of "grooming children."

To be frank, the Left has never made it easy for our students. That's always come with the territory when you're speaking truth deep in the belly of the beast... But this semester is different. This has been one of the most hostile semesters Turning Point USA students have ever faced. From coast to coast, high school and college students who dared to stand for faith, freedom, and this great nation have been stalked, slandered, threatened, and in some cases -- physically attacked. All for saying what you and I know to be true: That America is worth defending. That speech must remain free. And that Charlie Kirk's life and legacy meant something. And despite the opposition -- our students didn't back down. They didn't run. They didn't hide. They showed up -- earlier, louder, and stronger than ever before. But not without cost. Let me tell you more about what our students have been up against so far this year... In Maryland, one of our high school leaders -- just 17 years old -- helped organize a Club America event on campus back in December. It was peaceful. Students only. Parental permission required. No outside adults. Everything done by the book. And yet, weeks later, during a recent local school board meeting... A local woman stood up and publicly accused this student of "grooming children." Then she went even further. She told the board: " All members of this Board are mandatory reporters... Based on the circumstances surrounding this event, a report was made to Child Protective Services. " Yes, you read that right -- she weaponized CPS against one of our students. Filed against a minor. For organizing a pro-America Turning Point USA event with his friends. Now, I want you to imagine being 17 years old... doing everything right... following every rule... showing up with courage and conviction... And then hearing a stranger stand up in front of your entire community and imply that you're a danger to children. That you need to be investigated. That you're the problem. Above: "Nancy" -- the Leftist Karen who filed a CPS report against a local Club America chapter and spoke out against them at a recent school board meeting. How would you respond? Because I'll tell you what he did... He walked up to that microphone -- calm, steady, unshaken -- and said: " We have been accused of many things... I'm the president of the group. I'm 17, I'm a minor. I can't groom children because I am a child." Seventeen years old. Standing alone. But standing strong in front of his entire community while facing outrageous, malicious accusations. That's courage. The kind of courage Charlie would've been proud of. And that courage is catching fire across the country. But so is the hatred. Because what happened in Maryland wasn't an isolated incident... It's just the beginning: 🚨 At Lawrence University in Wisconsin, Leftists on campus are trying to permanently shut down a brand-new TPUSA chapter before it even starts. Never mind that Lawrence has over 160 student clubs... and not one is right-leaning. Or that the university handbook bans discrimination based on political affiliation. One of our students there is now receiving death threats. And instead of protecting him? The Left-wing student government is putting the chapter's fate up to a campus-wide vote. 🚨 At Iowa State University, Colby Brandt -- the student body president -- was threatened with impeachment because he had connections to TPUSA. Fortunately, his "impeachment" was dismissed by the student government's judicial branch... But this was only after the outrage that followed on social media and the university's administration came to its senses. 🚨 At Worcester Polytechnic, one of our signs that featured a quote with Charlie was vandalized with the phrase: "he should've ducked ahole." 🚨 At Lake Zurich High School, one of our students held an "I ❤️ ICE" sign -- and was physically threatened by a peer. No... but..." Then he added: " He was a racist piece of st. And Turning Point USA is a racist piece of st organization." The message was clear. I could go on and on with more examples of the Left's hatred towards our students... Our students are gathering to pray -- for their schools, for law enforcement, and for this nation -- quietly around their school's flagpole. That's because these students made a decision -- the same decision Charlie challenged them to every day: " It doesn't take skill to be courageous. It takes a choice." They chose courage. They chose to stand for faith, freedom, and family. They chose to defend everything that makes this country worth fighting for. They truly are the courageous generation. In fact, since Charlie 's assassination last September: 🔥 Over 140,000 students raised their hands to get involved 🔥 4,600+ active chapters are now operating across America 🔥 More than 1 million students are part of this movement And Peter, patriots like you are the reason they've been able to do it... Because while the Left mocked Charlie's death-- while the hate followed and the attacks intensified -- you didn't disappear. Patriots like you stood firm. You stood with these students. You made it clear: The mission doesn 't end here. And now, because of your faithfulness, we 're watching the seeds Charlie planted come to life in high schools, colleges, and communities across this country. Our students may not know your name... But they know someone made it possible for them to take a stand on their campus. They're walking into classrooms bolder than ever. Speaking truth in places where lies once ruled. Because someone gave them the chance. That someone was you. Patriots like you reminded these students that they're not alone -- even when it feels like it. You helped push back the darkness. You made space for courage to grow. The kind of courage Charlie lived for. The kind of courage he gave everything for. So, thank you, Peter. Thank you for giving these young patriots a fighting chance. We will not stop. We will not retreat. We will keep standing for truth -- louder and stronger than ever before. This week I went to the State of the Union with my sister-in-service Ilhan Omar, to stand up for the American people and show Trump that we don’t agree with him or his hate. I spoke out throughout Trump’s speech, calling out his constant lies. When he started demonizing our immigrant neighbors and falsely claiming that he protects Americans, I called him a liar and Ilhan yelled out that he has killed Americans, including her constituents. body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=9577%2E5257348%2EdwJ3AH ]Adam Schiff for Senate

I wanted to share some thoughts after Donald Trump’s State of the Union
address.

It was a dark, divisive, and deeply dishonest display,
Derek.

Rather than offering a vision to help working families, Trump used the
podium to settle scores.

He rambled on about Americans being too tired of winning. He told more
disgraceful lies about immigrants. He said our economy had never been
better, even though inflation is up, jobs are down, and our trade deficits
are worse than ever. And because he knows that the midterms are likely to
deal him a huge blow, he also threatened to interfere with the elections.

He made it clear that he isn’t interested in governing for all of us —
he’s interested in absolute power.

He said almost nothing about addressing the high cost of living, which, I
guess, shouldn’t surprise us because he thinks affordability is a hoax. I
guess you have to believe that if your main focus is building a golden
ballroom.

We saw the contrast last night. While my fellow Democrats and I are
fighting to lower costs for families and defend our very democracy, Trump
and his MAGA allies are focused on:

* Demonizing immigrants and continuing violent immigration raids.
* Rolling back the progress we made on climate change and healthcare.
* Handing out more tax breaks to the billionaire class while the rest of
us pay the price.
* Abandoning our allies abroad and cozying up to dictators.

Derek, the
State of the Union was yet another wake-up call. We cannot afford to be
complacent. The MAGA majority in Congress was cheering on his most
dangerous rhetoric, and they are ready to rubber-stamp his agenda if we
don’t stand in their way.

I’m doing everything in my power to hold this administration accountable
in the Senate, but I can’t do it alone.

# **The 2026 "Trump Effect"
on IRAs over $50,000**
---
**President Trump’s “One Big Beautiful Bill” is exactly what this country needs.** It’s big, it’s bold, and it’s finally putting American families first. But we have to be honest with you about something that’s hard to say. **Trump’s new plan is moving fast** ... maybe too fast for the old, fragile banking system to handle. Think of it like a powerful cleaning crew coming into a dusty old house. They are going to scrub everything clean, which is wonderful. But if you have fragile family heirlooms sitting out on shaky tables... they might get knocked over in the excitement. It’s not Trump’s fault. He is doing his job. **But the Wall Street banks holding your retirement savings are like those shaky tables.** They are old, tired, and not built for this kind of _**Economic Revolution**._ If you leave your money sitting there, it could get caught in the shake-up.
---
**This is why we hesitate to share this next part publicly.**
---
There is a way to move your **_financial heirloom_** to a safe room before the cleaning starts. It involves a specific, IRS-approved loophole that very few families know about. **To be honest, this loophole works so well it may feel a little unfair**. It allows you to quietly step out of the chaotic banking system to figuratively _**lock** _your savings into something that doesn't care about stock markets or bank failures. It can create a level of peace and quiet that most retirees never get to feel. While your neighbors are glued to the TV worrying about the next market swing, you can turn the TV off, knowing your grandkid's inheritance is sitting in a sanctuary that Wall Street can't touch.
---
# **[We’ve written down exactly how to use this loophole inside our 2026 Patriot’s Wealth Defense Guide.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**

But with the speed of Trump's changes, we feel a moral duty to share it with those who need to help protect their families. **If you are an American Citizen with more than $50,000 in retirement, you may already be eligible to receive the benefits detailed in this free guide.** [**Note: We also currently have a Silver Allocation Incentive*.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) | Friend, JD Vance was in Wisconsin today – and he didn’t miss out on the chance to sing the praises of my GOP opponent, Tom Tiffany. [Can you help me compete with Tiffany’s $2 million war chest and the support of the MAGA machine by chipping in today?](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mb-em-fr-feb26.oH05rx&amount=15&refcode=MB_EM_FR_022626_B1_JDRR&t=3&akid=5874%2E196590%2EX_nd7q)** | | [CHIP IN »](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mb-em-fr-feb26.oH05rx&amount=15&refcode=MB_EM_FR_022626_B1_JDRR&t=4&akid=5874%2E196590%2EX_nd7q)
---
Get this: Vance called Tom Tiffany a “great guy.” This is the same Tom Tiffany who:
* **Slashed hundreds of billions in Medicaid and food benefits** in the so-called “Big Beautiful Bill.”
* **Stripped Wisconsinites of their healthcare coverage** and caused their premiums to skyrocket.
* **Supports Trump’s disastrous tariffs** that are wrecking our farms and small businesses.
* **And blocked the release of the Epstein files.**

**Doesn't sound like a great guy to me.**
JD Vance also said that Tiffany was "another guy without whom we could not have accomplished all of the great things that we did in Washington DC."
**Are those “great things” the same ones raising prices across Wisconsin? Or maybe he’s referring to the tariffs that are forcing so many small businesses to close?**
**With today's full-throated support from Vance _as well as_ Trump's public endorsement, we know MAGA dark money is about to roll in by the millions. **
From day one, we’ve built our campaign on grassroots donors instead of corporate PACs or special interests, and I know if we come together, we can defeat the MAGA machine.
JD Vance thought he could stop by Wisconsin for just one day to reverse the year-long damage he and Donald Trump have wrought on our state. But I’m here for good, because we don’t need another politician to fly in and sell us lies.
[We’re going to show what the strength of a grassroots community looks like — that’s why I’m asking you to join us and pitch in today:](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mb-em-fr-feb26.oH05rx&amount=15&refcode=MB_EM_FR_022626_B1_JDRR&t=5&akid=5874%2E196590%2EX_nd7q)**

Hello Peter,
---
| | When you elect someone to represent you in Tennessee, you expect them to make your life better, not harder.
When you pay your taxes, you expect those dollars to strengthen public schools, build transportation infrastructure and improve your community and quality of life.
Instead of focusing on affordability, healthcare, or education, **extremist lawmakers in our state legislature are pushing harmful, discriminatory legislation, including Stephen Miller-crafted anti-immigrant bills and a bill to execute women who have an abortion.**** **

Yes. You read that correctly.
While Tennessee families struggle with rising costs, Republicans are pushing legislation that would allow the state to seek the death penalty for women who end their pregnancies.

This is outrageous, dangerous and cruel.
That’s why we’re organizing. We must hold them accountable.
We cannot do it without you.
[**Will you chip in $10, $25, or whatever you can today to help us fight back against extremism and elect leaders who will actually serve the people of Tennessee?**](https://zg05qvsd.r.us-east-2.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Four-tennessee-future-pac-1%3Frefcode=TENN26_EM_Feb/2/010f019c9c63babe-652e35b1-0e06-4caf-aa70-541a36848cf2-000000/3udGQG1il3kX25O9fXIMq-cS8h4=252)

Let’s get to work.

Chris Murdock

#

[
---
See, I get why some folks voted for Trump. He promised to attack a broken system. And it’s a ripe target. Even before Trump came on the scene, America had one of the most corrupt political systems in the Western world. It’s been running on corporate money, secret money, billionaire money. And it’s worse than ever now. _Citizens United_ was the worst court decision in modern American history. When members of Congress aren’t begging for money from Washington lobbyists, they’re trying to dodge getting carpet-bombed by super PACs. Senators get threatened with millions of dollars of attack ads over the votes they take. And see, _that_ is why things don’t work for ordinary people. It’s because the people’s elected representatives don’t represent the people. They represent the big donors! _That corruption is why they defunded nursing homes to cut taxes for the rich._ _Corruption is why you pay a fortune for prescriptions._ _Corruption is why your insurance claim keeps getting denied._ _Corruption is why hedge funds get to buy up all the houses in your neighborhood, and then your corporate landlord ignores your calls during a gas leak._ _Corruption is why that ambulance costs $3,000 after you just had to get your choking toddler to the hospital._ Yes, the system really is rigged. But Trump’s not unrigging it. He’s re-rigging it for himself! He’s a crook and a con man, and he wants to be a king. You can’t claim to be for ordinary men and women when you defund their hospitals and nursing homes. You can’t claim to be for ordinary men and women when you defund school lunch programs to help feed little boys and little girls whose hard-working parents are struggling to fill the fridge. You can’t claim to be for ordinary men and women when you do these things so you can cut taxes for the richest people in the country while you and your family business rake in massive sums from around the world. Donald Trump’s second term has already done unfathomable damage to our country and the lives of millions of people. And the people are beginning to see it. But only by regaining Congressional power can we stop him. _Really._ The upcoming 2026 midterms are our last chance to restore checks and balances. And my Senate race in Georgia is the single most critical contest: _I’m the only Democratic Senator up for reelection in 2026 in a state Trump carried in 2024._ **[So if you’re outraged by what’s happening to our country — and you’re ready to fight for the future of this Republic –– please don’t wait until 2028: Rush $5 to my reelection campaign in Georgia right now.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-feb26.GJoCgS&refcode=em260226-2-f&t=2&akid=1729%2E5691347%2EqZ502R) Here’s the link to donate: **[https://act.electjon.com/go/donate](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-feb26.GJoCgS&refcode=em260226-2-f&t=3&akid=1729%2E5691347%2EqZ502R)** The average online donation to our campaign is around $30. Please give what you can. All that matters is that lots and lots of people are contributing what they can to power our grassroots campaign. **[Please, contribute today.](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-feb26.GJoCgS&refcode=em260226-2-f&t=4&akid=1729%2E5691347%2EqZ502R)** Jon Ossoff
